title.en: Burnham to take Zelenskyy’s pleas for Patriot missiles to Trump – Europe live
title.zh: 伯纳姆将泽连斯基关于爱国者导弹的请求带给特朗普——欧洲直播

summary.en: UK Prime Minister Burnham is set to join a delegation of leaders lobbying the US president for increased supplies of Patriot missiles for Ukraine. Meanwhile, the Kremlin has accused Burnham of seeking to prolong the conflict. A Vatican envoy recently met with the Russian foreign minister in Moscow, emphasizing that...
summary.zh: 英国首相伯纳姆将加入一个领导人代表团，游说美国总统增加对乌克兰的爱国者导弹供应。与此同时，克里姆林宫指责伯纳姆寻求延长冲突。一位梵蒂冈特使最近在莫斯科会见了俄罗斯外交部长，强调“乌克兰战争必须结束”，并讨论了实现“乌克兰持久公正和平”的途径。

body.en: UK PM to join delegation of leaders lobbying US president to step up supplies, as Kremlin accuses Burnham of wanting to continue war Burnham plans trip to New York as Ukraine pleads for US-made missiles Vatican envoy Paul Gallagher met Russian foreign minister Sergei Lavrov in Moscow earlier today, and Reuters has some snap quotes from Pope Leo XIV’s representative following the meeting. He is quoted as saying that “The Ukrainian war must end” and that the pair discussed “avenues for pursuing lasting and just peace in Ukraine”. In relation to the post on a US military plane landing in Moscow (at 11:23 ), Reuters reported that the last time a US jet flew to Russia from Europe was in ​January, when special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled to Moscow to meet Vladimir Putin for peace talks. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国首相将与游说美国总统的领导人代表团一起游说美国总统增加供应，因为克里姆林宫指责伯纳姆想要继续战争。伯纳姆计划前往纽约，因为乌克兰请求美国制造的导弹。梵蒂冈特使保罗·加拉格尔今天早些时候在莫斯科会见了俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫，路透社在会后引用了教皇利奥十四世代表的一些简短言论。据报道，他表示“乌克兰战争必须结束”，两人讨论了“在乌克兰寻求持久和公正和平的途径”。关于美国军机降落在莫斯科的帖子（11点23分），路透社报道称，美国飞机上次从欧洲飞往俄罗斯是在一月份，当时特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳前往莫斯科会见弗拉基米尔·普京进行和平谈判。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Amidst ongoing pleas for military aid and accusations of prolonging conflict, the Vatican envoy's meeting with the Russian foreign minister to discuss "avenues for pursuing lasting and just peace" stands out. This effort reminds us of the divine call to a ministry of reconciliation, seeking to bridge divides and restore harmony even in the most entrenched...
reflection.zh: 在持续的军事援助请求和延长冲突的指责声中，梵蒂冈特使与俄罗斯外交部长会面，讨论“寻求持久公正和平的途径”，这一点尤为突出。这一努力提醒我们，雅伟呼召我们承担和好的职事，即使在最根深蒂固的冲突中，也要努力弥合分歧，恢复和谐。当领导人驾驭复杂的地缘政治格局时，追求和平，无论多么具有挑战性，仍然是一项深刻的人类和属灵的使命。

verse.textEn: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.
verse.textZh: 这一切都是出于神；他借着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。

title.en: CIA chief in Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
title.zh: 美国媒体报道称，中情局局长在莫斯科进行未公开的会谈

summary.en: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday. US media reports indicate the head of the CIA visited Moscow for unannounced talks.
summary.zh: 飞行跟踪数据显示，周二有一架美国军用飞机经拉脱维亚从美国飞往俄罗斯。美国媒体报道称，中央情报局局长前往莫斯科进行了未公开的会谈。

body.en:
The head of the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) travelled to Moscow for unannounced talks, the BBC's US news partner CBS has reported.

John Ratcliffe reportedly arrived in the Russian capital earlier on Tuesday. Neither Washington or Moscow have confirmed the nature of the visit or who he was due to meet.

Flight tracking data confirmed a large US military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday. It departed later on Tuesday.

Footage posted on social media showed the C-17 transport plane approaching Moscow's Vnukovo international airport.

It departed Riga airport at 05:50 GMT and appeared to have landed in the Russian capital at around 07:04 GMT, according to data from FlightRadar24. It left Moscow shortly before 16:00 GMT.

Footage on social media also purported to show a diplomatic motorcade travelling through Moscow.

The trip is thought to be Ratcliffe's first trip to Russia as CIA director, although he has maintained contact with his intelligence counterparts in Moscow.

He played a role in negotiations for the release of Russian-American citizen Ksenia Karelina's, who was jailed in Russia for over a year after being accused of providing support to Ukraine.

The CIA was also involved in a 2024 prisoner swap deal with Russia that saw the release of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich, as well as former US marine Paul Whelan and Russian-American journalist Alsu Kurmasheva.

The US has had strained relations with Russia since it launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since then, Russia has been isolated on the world stage and faced international economic sanctions.

Ratcliffe appears to be one of the highest-ranking US officials to visit the country during President Donald Trump's second term.

Trump met Russian President Vladimir Putin at a summit in Alaska last year but the meeting did not lead to a breakthrough. Subsequent US-led peace talks between Russia and Ukraine appear to have stalled.
body.zh: 据英国广播公司（BBC）美国新闻合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）报道，美国中央情报局（CIA）局长前往莫斯科进行未经宣布的会谈。 据报道，约翰·拉特克利夫于周二早些时候抵达俄罗斯首都。华盛顿和莫斯科都没有证实这次访问的性质或他将与谁会面。 飞行跟踪数据证实，一架大型美国军用飞机周二从美国经拉脱维亚飞往俄罗斯。该航班于周二晚些时候出发。 社交媒体上发布的视频显示，这架C-17运输机正在接近莫斯科伏努科沃国际机场。 根据 FlightRadar24 的数据，这架飞机于格林威治标准时间 05:50 离开里加机场，并于格林威治标准时间 07:04 左右降落在俄罗斯首都。它于格林尼治标准时间 16:00 之前不久离开莫斯科。 社交媒体上的视频也据称显示外交车队穿越莫斯科。 这次旅行被认为是拉特克利夫作为中央情报局局长首次访问俄罗斯，尽管他一直与莫斯科的情报同行保持联系。 他在释放俄裔美国公民克塞尼亚·卡列利娜的谈判中发挥了作用，卡列利娜因被指控向乌克兰提供支持而在俄罗斯被监禁一年多。 中央情报局还参与了 2024 年与俄罗斯的囚犯交换协议，该协议释放了《华尔街日报》记者埃文·格什科维奇、前美国海军陆战队员保罗·惠兰和俄裔美国记者阿尔苏·库尔马舍娃。 自2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，美国与俄罗斯的关系一直紧张。此后，俄罗斯在世界舞台上被孤立，并面临国际经济制裁。 拉特克利夫似乎是唐纳德·特朗普总统第二任期内访问该国的最高级别的美国官员之一。 特朗普去年在阿拉斯加峰会上会见了俄罗斯总统普京，但会议并未取得突破。随后美国主导的俄罗斯和乌克兰和平谈判似乎陷入僵局。

reflection.en: In a world often marked by suspicion and tension, the clandestine journey of the CIA chief to Moscow speaks to the persistent, behind-the-scenes efforts to maintain communication and seek understanding. Even when direct confirmation is absent, the act of dialogue itself, however discreet, is a step toward peace.
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满猜疑和紧张的世界里，中央情报局局长秘密前往莫斯科的行程，体现了为维持沟通和寻求理解而进行的持续的幕后努力。即使没有直接的确认，对话本身，无论多么谨慎，也是迈向和平的一步。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Canada announces 50% retaliatory tariffs on hundreds of US goods as trade war escalates – live
title.zh: 特朗普称在与加拿大的贸易战中可能将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”

summary.en: Donald Trump suggested renaming Lake Ontario to "Lake America" amid escalating trade tensions with Canada. He also used social media to deny interfering with French language protections while criticizing Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau's leadership.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在与加拿大的贸易紧张局势升级之际，提议将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”。他还在社交媒体上否认干预法语保护政策，同时批评加拿大总理贾斯廷·特鲁多的领导能力。

body.en: Move by Canada comes after US president spent morning railing against the country, calling it the ‘most difficult’ nation he deals with Sign up for the US Breaking News email On Truth Social, however, the president shot down assertions that the US talks with Canada collapsed in part due a proposed trade deal that would have weakened French language protections . “I would never interfere with Canadians speaking French!” he wrote. “In fact, I have never even thought of doing such a stupid thing. This lie was made up by a weak and ineffective Prime Minister in an attempt to gain political support, which he has totally lost, from the people of Quebec.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 安大略湖位于两国边境，一侧是纽约州，另一侧是加拿大安大略省首府多伦多。然而，总统驳斥了有关美国与加拿大谈判破裂部分原因是拟议的贸易协议的说法，该协议将削弱法语保护。 “我永远不会干涉加拿大人说法语！”他写道。 “事实上，我从来没有想过做这么愚蠢的事情。这个谎言是由一位软弱无能的总理编造的，目的是获得魁北克人民的政治支持，而他已经完全失去了政治支持。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The shared waters of Lake Ontario serve as a physical reminder of the interconnectedness between the United States and Canada. When political rhetoric turns toward renaming shared resources or personal criticism, it challenges the biblical mandate to pursue peace with our neighbors. Yahweh calls us to seek harmony as far as it depends on us, recognizing...
reflection.zh: 安大略湖的共有水域提醒着美国与加拿大之间紧密的地理联系。当政治辞令转向重新命名共有资源或进行人身攻击时，这挑战了圣经中关于与邻舍追求和睦的诫命。雅伟呼吁我们在可能的范围内寻求和谐，因为我们应当意识到，言语既有能力弥合国家间的鸿沟，也有可能使其扩大。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: CIA director John Ratcliffe reportedly on Moscow visit
title.zh: 据报中情局局长拉特克利夫访问莫斯科

summary.en: US media has reported that CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an unannounced visit to Moscow, marking his first known trip to Russia in his current role. Flight data indicated an American military aircraft flew to the Russian capital, where a US diplomatic motorcade was later observed.
summary.zh: 美国媒体报道称，中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫对莫斯科进行了一次未经宣布的访问，这是他担任现职以来首次已知访问俄罗斯。飞行数据显示，一架美国军用飞机飞往俄罗斯首都，随后在那里观察到了美国外交车队。

body.en: Unannounced trip reported by US media is said to be Ratcliffe’s first known visit to Russia as CIA chief The CIA director, John Ratcliffe, has made an unannounced visit to Moscow, US media reported, after flight data showed an American military aircraft flew to the Russian capital, where a US diplomatic motorcade was later spotted. CBS News quoted sources familiar with the situation as confirming Ratcliffe’s trip, saying it was his first known visit to Russia as CIA chief. Axios separately confirmed the visit, quoting a US official. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国媒体报道的这次秘密访问据说是拉特克利夫作为中央情报局局长首次对俄罗斯进行已知的访问 美国媒体报道称，飞行数据显示一架美国军用飞机飞往俄罗斯首都，随后在莫斯科发现了美国外交车队，美国中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫对莫斯科进行了一次秘密访问。哥伦比亚广播公司新闻援引知情人士的话证实了拉特克利夫的访问，称这是他作为中央情报局局长首次访问俄罗斯。 Axios 援引一位美国官员的话单独证实了此次访问。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world often marked by tension and mistrust, the reported unannounced visit of the CIA director to Moscow speaks to the ongoing, often unseen, efforts to navigate complex international relations. Even in adversarial contexts, the pursuit of dialogue and understanding, however difficult, remains a vital aspect of seeking peace.
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满紧张和不信任的世界里，中情局局长据报对莫斯科进行秘密访问，这表明在复杂国际关系中持续进行着不为人知的努力。即使在敌对的环境中，寻求对话和理解，无论多么困难，仍然是寻求和平的一个重要方面。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: London bus drivers resume strike over heatwave working amid fears over air con deal
title.zh: 伦敦公交车司机因高温天气罢工，担心空调改造协议

summary.en: London bus drivers have resumed strike action over working in high temperatures, with concerns that the bus operator's offer to retrofit air conditioning on 730 buses may not be completed by next summer. Approximately 1,500 Unite union members are participating in the four-day strike.
summary.zh: 伦敦公交车司机因在高温下工作而恢复罢工，担心公交运营商提出的为730辆公交车改造空调的提议可能无法在明年夏天前完成。约有1500名联合工会成员参与了为期四天的罢工。

body.en: Drivers concerned that bus operator’s offer to retrofit cabs on 730 buses will not be complete by next summer London bus drivers have resumed strike action over having to work in high temperatures, amid fears that proposed improvements to air conditioning will not be complete by next summer. About 1,500 members of the Unite union working across north London and Essex are taking part in the four-day strike from Tuesday to Friday, after industrial action earlier this month. Further stoppages are planned for the coming weeks. Continue reading...
body.zh: 司机们担心公交车运营商对 730 辆公交车改造驾驶室的提议将无法在明年夏天完成 伦敦公交车司机因必须在高温下工作而恢复了罢工行动，因为人们担心拟议的空调改进措施将无法在明年夏天完成。在本月早些时候的罢工行动之后，伦敦北部和埃塞克斯的联合工会约 1,500 名成员参加了周二至周五为期四天的罢工。未来几周计划进一步停工。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The drivers' strike over working conditions in extreme heat brings to mind the call to do all work as if for Yahweh. While the immediate issue is comfort and safety, the underlying principle is the dignity of labor and the responsibility to perform one's duties with diligence, regardless of the circumstances. May all workers find their efforts valued and...
reflection.zh: 司机们因极端高温下的工作条件而罢工，这让人想起要凡事都像为主而做。虽然眼前的问题是舒适和安全，但其根本原则是劳动的尊严以及无论在何种情况下都应勤勉尽责地履行职责。愿所有劳动者都能找到他们的付出被重视，他们的福祉得到考虑。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: US consumer confidence falls in August as gas prices remain above $4 per gallon
title.zh: 美国8月消费者信心因汽油价格维持在4美元以上而下降

summary.en: US consumer confidence fell to 89.4 in August, its lowest level in seven months, as Americans grapple with gasoline prices exceeding $4 per gallon and five years of persistent inflation. The decline is attributed to ongoing regional conflicts and the cumulative weight of high living costs on household sentiment.
summary.zh: 美国8月消费者信心指数从7月的90.2降至89.4，为七个月来的最低水平。由于伊朗冲突持续推高汽油价格至每加仑4美元以上，加之长达五年的通胀压力，美国民众对经济的信心再次下滑。

body.en: Confidence index drops to 89.4 in August from 90.2 in July amid frustration after five years of elevated inflation Americans’ confidence in the economy declined again this month as the ongoing conflict in Iran continued to push US gasoline prices above $4 per gallon. The Conference Board said on Tuesday that its consumer confidence index dipped to 89.4 in August from 90.2 in July. That was the lowest level in seven months but was essentially within the same lukewarm range it has been in since the beginning of the year. In late 2024 and early 2025, readings were consistently above 100. Continue reading...
body.zh: 信心指数从 7 月的 90.2 降至 8 月的 89.4，五年来通货膨胀率上升，美国人对经济的信心本月再次下降，因为伊朗持续的冲突继续推动美国汽油价格超过每加仑 4 美元。世界大型企业联合会周二表示，其消费者信心指数从 7 月的 90.2 降至 8 月的 89.4。这是七个月以来的最低水平，但基本上处于年初以来的温和区间内。 2024 年底和 2025 年初，读数始终高于 100。继续阅读...

reflection.en: When gas prices climb and inflation lingers, it is natural for our sense of security to waver alongside the economic indices. Yet, the prophet Habakkuk reminds us that even when the fields produce no food and the stalls are empty, our ultimate hope is not anchored in market stability. True peace comes from trusting Yahweh’s presence even when the cost of...
reflection.zh: 当汽油价格攀升、通胀持续时，我们的安全感往往会随着经济指标一同动摇。然而，先知哈巴谷提醒我们，即便“田地不出粮食”、“棚内也没有牛”，我们最终的盼望并不锚定在市场的稳定上。真正的平安源于在生活成本沉重之时，依然选择信靠雅伟的同在。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Houthi strikes threaten to pull Yemen back into full-scale war
title.zh: 胡塞武装袭击恐将也门拖回全面战争

summary.en: The Iran-backed Houthis are using regional warfare to increase pressure on Saudi Arabia, while their attacks risk reopening Yemen's own conflict and disrupting shipping in the Red Sea.
summary.zh: 受伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在利用地区冲突向沙特阿拉伯施压，其袭击行动有可能重新点燃也门自身的冲突，并扰乱红海航运。

body.en:
The Iran-backed Houthis are using regional warfare to increase pressure on Saudi Arabia, while their attacks risk reopening Yemen's own conflict and disrupting shipping in the Red Sea.

Yemen is increasingly at risk of backsliding into full-scale conflict. On Monday, Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi militia attacked another crude oil tanker in the Red Sea off the coast of Saudi Arabia. The attack followed earlier strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure and other ships in the nearby Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

The waterway connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and has served as an alternative route for oil exports from Saudi Arabia and other Gulf countries affected by Iran's ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

In August, the Houthis also attacked areas under the control of the Saudi-backed Yemeni government, particularly the port city of Mokha. Yemen's  internationally recognized government targeted Houthi infrastructure in response.

"Mokha overlooks the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which is strategically important to the Houthis," Hisham Al-Omeisy, a Yemeni conflict analyst, told DW. "In the long term, the Houthis want to weaken the government's control over the Red Sea coastal areas and they aim for full control of the governate Al-Hudeydah [of which Mokha is a part] to continue their strategy of exerting pressure on global maritime trade ," he predicted.

The current military flare-up ended four years of relative calm between the Houthis and Yemen's internationally recognized government, backed by Saudi Arabia.

However, Al-Omeisy notes that there are also two other aspects that drive the latest Houthi strategy.

Following the ceasefire in 2022, Saudi Arabia has continued to support the Yemeni government financially and militarily. Saudi Arabia also never fully lifted its air and port blockades in areas under Houthi control. Despite this, the Houthis  consolidated  their position as Yemen's de facto rulers. In Al-Omeisy's view, the Houthis now hope to extract additional concessions from Saudi Arabia.

"The Houthis are under a lot of pressure locally to deliver on their promises, for example, to reform the government, pay salaries and improve livelihoods," Al-Omeisy said. He therefore believes that the Houthis are using the wider Middle East war to distract from their failure to deliver in these areas by "saying that we are now busy with another war."

The Houthi strikes are also carefully timed, Al-Omeisy added. "They've learned their lessons from how Iran  managed to basically dominate the Strait of Hormuz," he said, adding that the blockade of imports and oil exports leaves Saudi Arabia in a very vulnerable position.

body.zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在利用地区战争来增加对沙特阿拉伯的压力，而他们的袭击可能会重新引发也门自身的冲突并扰乱红海的航运。 也门越来越面临陷入全面冲突的风险。周一，也门伊朗支持的胡塞民兵在沙特阿拉伯海岸附近的红海袭击了另一艘原油油轮。此前，沙特石油基础设施和附近曼德海峡附近的其他船只也遭到袭击。 该水道连接红海与亚丁湾，并成为沙特阿拉伯和其他受伊朗持续封锁霍尔木兹海峡影响的海湾国家石油出口的替代路线。 8月，胡塞武装还袭击了沙特支持的也门政府控制下的地区，特别是港口城市莫卡。作为回应，国际公认的也门政府以胡塞武装基础设施为目标。 也门冲突分析人士希沙姆·奥梅西 (Hisham Al-Omeisy) 告诉德国之声：“莫卡俯瞰红海和曼德海峡，这对胡塞武装具有重要的战略意义。” “从长远来看，胡塞武装希望削弱政府对红海沿岸地区的控制，他们的目标是完全控制荷台达省（莫卡所属），以继续他们对全球海上贸易施加压力的战略，”他预测。 当前的军事冲突结束了胡塞武装和沙特阿拉伯支持的也门国际公认政府之间四年的相对平静。 然而，奥梅西指出，还有其他两个方面推动了胡塞武装的最新战略。 2022年停火后，沙特阿拉伯继续在财政和军事上支持也门政府。沙特阿拉伯也从未完全解除对胡塞武装控制地区的空中和港口封锁。尽管如此，胡塞武装巩固了他们作为也门事实上统治者的地位。 奥梅西认为，胡塞武装现在希望从沙特阿拉伯获得更多让步。 奥梅西说：“胡塞武装在当地面临着兑现承诺的巨大压力，例如改革政府、支付工资和改善生计。”因此，他认为胡塞武装正在利用更广泛的中东战争，通过“说我们现在正忙于另一场战争”来转移人们对他们在这些地区未能兑现承诺的注意力。 奥梅西补充说，胡塞武装的袭击时机也很谨慎。他说：“他们从伊朗如何基本上控制霍尔木兹海峡中吸取了教训。”他补充说，进口和石油出口的封锁使沙特阿拉伯处于非常脆弱的境地。 “也门的不稳定不再只是沙特阿拉伯南部边境的问题，”爱丽丝......

reflection.en: The Houthi militia's recent attacks on crude oil tankers and Saudi infrastructure in the Red Sea region highlight the perilous path of escalating violence. When groups resort to armed force, as the Houthis are doing, the risk of a wider, devastating conflict, pulling Yemen back into full-scale war, becomes tragically real. This echoes the sober warning that...
reflection.zh: 胡塞武装最近在红海地区袭击原油油轮和沙特基础设施，凸显了暴力升级的危险道路。当团体诉诸武力时，就像胡塞武装正在做的那样，一场更广泛、更具破坏性的冲突——将也门拖回全面战争——的风险就变得真实而悲剧。这呼应了“凡动刀的，必死在刀下”的严肃警告，提醒我们暴力所延续的破坏性循环。

title.en: Swedish military seeks to take over Russian-owned estate near naval base
title.zh: 瑞典军方寻求接管海军基地附近的俄属房产

summary.en: The Swedish military has requested the government to expropriate a Russian-owned luxury estate near the Muskö Naval Base, citing security risks from drones and the owner's links to the Russian state. This move follows Sweden's recent entry into NATO, ending two centuries of military non-alignment after the invasion of...
summary.zh: 瑞典军方已请求政府征收穆斯克海军基地附近的一处俄罗斯人拥有的豪华房产，理由是无人机威胁以及业主与俄罗斯政府的关系。此举发生在瑞典最近加入北约之后，在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，瑞典结束了长达两个世纪的军事不结盟政策。

body.en:
Sweden's armed forces have asked the government to expropriate a Russia-owned property near a naval base on security grounds.

The military requested the seizure of the beach plot near Muskö base in Stockholm archipelago, citing "the threat from Russian drones and the ownership situation of the property".

Swedish reports say a businessman with links to the Russian state, has been building a luxury house on Muskö island – although his wife, who holds both Russian and Swedish citizenship, is the registered owner.

Two years ago, Sweden ended two centuries of military non-alignment and joined Nato because of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

In its statement, the military said the location had "unique conditions for strengthening the defence of Muskö Naval Base, particularly against drones".

The development of Russian drone warfare has "changed the threat landscape for Sweden", the military added.

Public broadcaster SVT said the property has been "a thorn in the armed forces' side".

Defence Minister Pål Jonson said the country needed to "make sure there's no risk of anyone gaining visibility into the site or any kind of tactical edge", Sweden's TV4 reported.

The armed forces' statement quoted Chief of the Defence Staff Carl-Johan Edström as saying that Sweden was "facing the most serious security situation since the end of World War Two".
body.zh: 瑞典武装部队以安全为由要求政府征用海军基地附近俄罗斯拥有的财产。 军方要求没收斯德哥尔摩群岛穆斯科基地附近的海滩地块，理由是“来自俄罗斯无人机的威胁以及该财产的所有权状况”。 瑞典报道称，一名与俄罗斯政府有联系的商人一直在穆斯科岛上建造一座豪华住宅，尽管他的妻子拥有俄罗斯和瑞典公民身份，但她是登记业主。 两年前，瑞典因俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰而结束了两个世纪的军事不结盟，加入北约。 军方在声明中表示，该地点“具有加强穆斯科海军基地防御的独特条件，特别是针对无人机的防御”。 军方补充说，俄罗斯无人机战争的发展“改变了瑞典的威胁格局”。 公共广播公司 SVT 表示，该房产一直是“武装部队的眼中钉”。 据瑞典 TV4 报道，国防部长帕尔·琼森 (Pål Jonson) 表示，该国需要“确保不存在任何人看到该地点或获得任何战术优势的风险”。 武装部队声明援引国防参谋长卡尔-约翰·埃德斯特罗姆的话说，瑞典“面临着第二次世界大战结束以来最严重的安全局势”。

reflection.en: The Swedish military's request to seize property near the Muskö base reflects a nation grappling with a new era of vulnerability. After two centuries of neutrality, the proximity of potential surveillance reminds us how quickly a sense of safety can be shaken. In times of geopolitical shifting, we look to Yahweh as the ultimate source of strength who stands...
reflection.zh: 瑞典军方请求征收穆斯克基地附近的房产，反映了一个国家正在应对新的脆弱时期。在经历了两个世纪的中立之后，潜在监控的逼近提醒我们，安全感是多么容易被动摇。在地缘政治动荡的时刻，我们仰望雅伟，祂是那些面对不确定性之人的力量源泉，并与他们同在。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹

summary.en: Cases in the US have hit the highest point since the virus was eliminated, as vaccination rates decline.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two people who were not vaccinated against measles have died of the virus in Pennsylvania, health officials said.

The state has seen 393 cases of the highly contagious virus this year, as infections across the US have hit the highest point in 35 years.

Last year, two unvaccinated children in Texas died from a measles outbreak that infected over 1,000 people, primarily children.

Eighty-five percent of kindergarten-age students in Lancaster County, where the recent deaths occurred, are vaccinated against measles - well below the 95% rate needed for herd immunity to limit the spread and protect immunocompromised people.

"My deepest sympathies are with the loved ones who are facing this unimaginable loss," Pennsylvania Secretary of Health Debra Bogen said in a statement.

"Because measles was largely eliminated in the Commonwealth for more than three decades, people are not familiar with this disease and don't fully understand the potential severity of the illness."

She added that the mumps, measles and rubella (MMR) vaccine provides the best protection against illness and death. The health department did not share any additional information on the identities of those who died.

The US has seen 2,777 confirmed cases of measles in 2026, just seven months into the year, up from last year's high of 2,289.

The rising number of cases comes as vaccine hesitancy in the US has increased in recent years, leading to lower immunisation rates. The US recommends two shots to children between ages one and six, which is 97% effective in protecting against the illness.

Earlier this month, President Donald Trump signed an executive order that calls for fewer childhood vaccinations and recommends splitting the MMR vaccine into three separate shots. Public health experts worry the order will cause confusion about an already safe and effective vaccine and prove costly.

The executive order came after Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr took a number of steps to remake US vaccine policies over the past year, including the childhood vaccination schedule. Many of the changes were blocked by a federal judge earlier this year.

A vaccine skeptic, Kennedy has shared mixed messaging on MMR vaccine, at times endorsing it and other times sharing unproven claims about its safety.

The US is on track to lose its status of having eliminated measles, which will be determined by a panel in November. Canada lost its status last year.
body.zh: 卫生官员称，宾夕法尼亚州有两名未接种麻疹疫苗的人死于该病毒。 今年该州已出现 393 例这种高传染性病毒病例，美国各地的感染人数已达到 35 年来的最高点。 去年，德克萨斯州两名未接种疫苗的儿童死于麻疹疫情，麻疹疫情导致 1,000 多人感染，其中主要是儿童。 最近发生死亡事件的兰卡斯特县，85% 的幼儿园适龄学生接种了麻疹疫苗，远低于限制传播和保护免疫功能低下人群所需的群体免疫 95% 的疫苗接种率。 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部长黛布拉·博根在一份声明中表示：“我对面临这一难以想象的损失的亲人表示最深切的同情。” “由于三十多年来麻疹在英联邦已基本消除，人们对这种疾病并不熟悉，也不完全了解这种疾病的潜在严重性。” 她补充说，腮腺炎、麻疹和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗可提供预防疾病和死亡的最佳保护。卫生部门没有透露有关死者身份的任何其他信息。 2026 年仅 7 个月，美国就有 2,777 例麻疹确诊病例，高于去年最高的 2,289 例。 近年来，美国民众对疫苗犹豫不决，导致免疫率下降，导致病例数量不断增加。美国建议一岁到六岁的儿童注射两次疫苗，预防这种疾病的有效率为 97%。 本月早些时候，唐纳德·特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，呼吁减少儿童接种疫苗，并建议将 MMR 疫苗分为三针。公共卫生专家担心，该命令将导致人们对已经安全有效的疫苗产生混淆，并且成本高昂。 这项行政命令是在卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪在过去一年采取了一系列措施重新制定美国疫苗政策（包括儿童疫苗接种计划）之后发布的。今年早些时候，联邦法官阻止了许多变更。 作为一名疫苗怀疑论者，肯尼迪分享了有关 MMR 疫苗的复杂信息，有时支持该疫苗，有时则分享有关其安全性未经证实的说法。 美国有望失去已消除麻疹的地位，该委员会将于 11 月做出决定。加拿大去年失去了地位。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Nigeria's jet fuel conundrum: Scarcity at home, abundance abroad
title.zh: 尼日利亚航空燃油困局：出口欧洲丰盈，国内供应短缺

summary.en: Nigeria has emerged as Europe's largest supplier of jet fuel, overtaking the United States, as the massive 650,000 bpd Dangote refinery near Lagos fills gaps left by Middle Eastern supply disruptions. However, while the refinery boosts Europe's reserves, Nigeria's own domestic airlines continue to struggle with severe...
summary.zh: 尼日利亚已超越美国成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应商，位于拉各斯附近、日产65万桶的丹格特巨型炼油厂填补了中东供应中断留下的缺口。然而，尽管该炼油厂增强了欧洲的储备，尼日利亚国内航空公司仍面临严重的燃油短缺和高昂成本，凸显了该国工业产出与内部需求之间的巨大差距。

body.en:
Nigeria is fast becoming Europe's biggest jet fuel supplier, as it continues to help ease ongoing shortages abroad. Meanwhile at home, the West African country’s own airlines are struggling to keep their tanks full.

For the past two months. Nigeria has emerged as Europe's largest supplier of jet fuel , overtaking the United States.

The 650,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) mega refinery owned by Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, outside Lagos has evolved into an increasingly important source of fuel for the continent following supply disruptions caused by the Iran war.

During last year's peak summer months, the majority of these supplies still originated from the Middle East.

But since the closure of the Strait of Hormuz earlier this year, Europe has been relying on imports of roughly 700,000 bpd in total to meet the present demands of the aviation industry, according to the private, global trade intelligence business Kpler.

In fact, back in April, the head of the International Energy Agency Fatih Birol expressed concern that at the time Europe only had "maybe six weeks or so" of jet fuel supplies remaining.

Less than two months later, four airports in northern Italy — Bologna, Venice, Treviso and Milan's Linate — even introduced temporary restrictions on jet fuel use, imposing a ceiling of 2,000 liters per aircraft for short-haul journeys, according to local media, while giving priority to medical and long-haul flights.

Europe has, in the meantime, been able to absorb the shock of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz by diversifying its resources and boosting supplies from countries like Nigeria — but at what cost?

Nigeria continues to produce a record amount of jet fuel through the Dangote refinery, equivalent to about 24 million liters each day, with much of this now being shipped to Europe.

But domestic airlines in the West African country meanwhile appear to struggle to keep up with their  daily estimated needs because of the surge in prices and the demands of the free market.

Ikemesit Effiong, a partner at the Africa-focused SBM intelligence consultancy, explained that "Nigeria operates a fully deregulated downstream market where Dangote prices its products with reference to international parity, not preferential domestic rates."

"Fuel flows to wherever pays the most," he told DW, adding that "currently, that is Europe, not Lagos."

"The key lesson Nigerian players are learning is that production capacity alone does not guarantee affordability at home."

While the Dangote refinery has significantly improved fuel availability in the country, which has long been plagued by chronic fuel scarcity and long queues at petrol stations, domestic prices are still among the highest on the continent.

In the fully deregulated Nigerian...
body.zh: 尼日利亚正在迅速成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应国，因为它继续帮助缓解国外持续的短缺问题。与此同时，在国内，这个西非国家自己的航空公司正在努力保持油箱满载。 过去两个月。尼日利亚已超过美国，成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应国。 非洲首富阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 拥有的这座日产量 65 万桶 (bpd) 的大型炼油厂位于拉各斯郊外，在伊朗战争造成供应中断后，该炼油厂已成为非洲大陆日益重要的燃料来源。 在去年的夏季高峰期间，大部分供应仍然来自中东。 但据私营全球贸易情报公司 Kpler 称，自今年早些时候霍尔木兹海峡关闭以来，欧洲一直依赖每天约 70 万桶的进口来满足航空业目前的需求。 事实上，早在四月份，国际能源署署长法提赫·比罗尔就表示担心，当时欧洲只剩下“大约六周”的航空燃油供应。 据当地媒体报道，不到两个月后，意大利北部的四个机场——博洛尼亚、威尼斯、特雷维索和米兰利纳特——甚至对航空燃油的使用实行了临时限制，对短途旅行实行每架飞机2000升的上限，同时优先考虑医疗和长途航班。 与此同时，欧洲已经能够通过资源多元化和增加尼日利亚等国家的供应来吸收霍尔木兹海峡关闭的冲击——但代价是什么？ 尼日利亚通过丹格特炼油厂继续生产创纪录数量的航空燃油，相当于每天约 2400 万升，其中大部分现在运往欧洲。 但与此同时，由于价格飙升和自由市场的需求，这个西非国家的国内航空公司似乎难以满足其每日预计需求。 专注于非洲的 SBM 情报咨询公司的合伙人 Ikemesit Effiong 解释说，“尼日利亚经营着一个完全放松管制的下游市场，丹格特参照国际平价而非国内优惠价格为其产品定价。” 他告诉德国之声：“燃料流向价格最高的地方。”他补充道，“目前是欧洲，而不是拉各斯。” “尼日利亚企业学到的重要教训是，仅靠生产能力并不能保证国内的负担能力。” 虽然丹格特炼油厂显着改善了该国的燃料供应，但该国长期以来一直受到燃料短缺和加油站排长队的困扰，但国内价格仍然是非洲大陆最高的之一。 在完全放松管制的尼日利亚...

reflection.en: The emergence of the Dangote refinery as a global powerhouse is a feat of industry, yet it creates a painful irony for Nigerians on the ground. When a nation’s resources bring relief to distant lands while its own people struggle to keep their planes in the air, it raises profound questions about the purpose of economic growth. Yahweh calls those in...
reflection.zh: 丹格特炼油厂成为全球能源重镇是工业上的壮举，但对尼日利亚民众而言却充满了讽刺。当一个国家的资源在缓解远方土地的短缺，而本国航空公司却连油箱都难以填满时，这引发了关于经济增长目的的深刻思考。雅伟呼吁领导者施行公义，确保土地的馈赠得到妥善管理，以维系其所服务之国民的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Will Iran withdraw from nuclear non-proliferation treaty?
title.zh: 伊朗是否会退出《不扩散核武器条约》？

summary.en: Iranian lawmakers are considering withdrawing from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) amid ongoing tensions with the United States. While some officials see withdrawal as a response to economic pressure, analysts suggest the threat itself is a strategic move to gain diplomatic leverage.
summary.zh: 在与美国持续紧张的局势中，伊朗立法者正在考虑退出《不扩散核武器条约》（NPT）。尽管一些官员认为退出是对经济压力的回应，但分析人士指出，这一威胁本身是获取外交筹码的战略举措。

body.en:
Iranian lawmakers have again raised the possibility of leaving a decades-old international nuclear weapons treaty. Analysts say the threat to quit may offer Tehran more leverage than an actual withdrawal.

Lawmakers in Iran have once again raised the possibility of leaving the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) as tensions over Tehran's nuclear program and its standoff with the United States continue.

Iranian MP Ghasem Ravanbakhsh said a proposal to withdraw from the landmark treaty had been submitted and was being considered. 

Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, said a withdrawal would be the "best response" to increased US economic pressure.

The idea is not new. Iranian officials and lawmakers have repeatedly raised it during periods of tension with Western governments. However, it remains unclear whether Tehran is actually preparing to leave the treaty or whether the threat itself is the objective.

In 1970, Iran ratified the agreement, which is the main international treaty on nuclear non-proliferation.

The NPT has 191 member states and is based on preventing the spread of nuclear weapons , promoting peaceful nuclear cooperation and pursuing nuclear disarmament.

Any member can withdraw if it believes that extraordinary events related to the treaty have put its supreme national interests at risk.

It must give three months' notice to the other members and the UN Security Council and explain its reasons. Leaving the treaty is therefore legally possible.

Behrooz Bayat, a nuclear expert and former consultant to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) , told DW that the process would take time.

"A withdrawal would almost certainly be seen internationally as a signal that Iran intends either to keep open the option of developing nuclear weapons or to move toward doing so," Bayat said.

He said such a perception could sharply increase political and economic pressure and potentially raise the risk of further military action.

For that reason, Bayat believes Tehran's repeated threats are more useful as diplomatic leverage than as a policy it actually intends to pursue.

Shahin Modarres, an international security analyst and researcher at LUISS University in Rome, told DW that the renewed debate should be seen in the context of stalled negotiations over uranium enrichment and Iran's stockpile of highly enriched uranium.

Iran has about 440 kilograms (972 pounds) of uranium that is enriched up to 60% purity , a short, technical step from weapons-grade levels of 90%, according to the IAEA.

Inspectors from the UN's nuclear watchdog were unable to verify the location of much of the material after the June 2025 US and Israeli strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities .

body.zh: 伊朗立法者再次提出退出已有数十年历史的国际核武器条约的可能性。分析人士表示，威胁退出可能会给德黑兰带来比实际退出更大的筹码。 随着德黑兰核计划及其与美国对峙的紧张局势持续，伊朗立法者再次提出退出《核不扩散条约》（NPT）的可能性。 伊朗议员加西姆·拉万巴赫什表示，一项退出这一具有里程碑意义的条约的提案已经提交并正在考虑中。 国家安全和外交政策委员会成员易卜拉欣·雷扎伊表示，撤军将是对美国经济压力加大的“最佳回应”。 这个想法并不新鲜。在与西方政府关系紧张期间，伊朗官员和立法者多次提出这一问题。然而，目前尚不清楚德黑兰是否真的准备退出该条约，或者威胁本身是否是目标。 1970 年，伊朗批准了该协议，这是关于核不扩散的主要国际条约。 《不扩散核武器条约》有191个成员国，其宗旨是防止核武器扩散、促进和平核合作、追求核裁军。 如果任何成员认为与该条约有关的异常事件使其最高国家利益面临风险，则可以退出。 它必须提前三个月通知其他成员国和联合国安理会并解释理由。因此，退出该条约在法律上是可能的。 核专家、国际原子能机构（IAEA）前顾问贝赫鲁兹·巴亚特（Behrooz Bayat）告诉德国之声，这一过程需要时间。 巴亚特说：“撤军几乎肯定会被国际社会视为一个信号，表明伊朗打算保留发展核武器的选择，或者迈向发展核武器。” 他表示，这种看法可能会急剧增加政治和经济压力，并可能增加采取进一步军事行动的风险。 因此，巴亚特认为，德黑兰一再发出的威胁作为外交筹码比作为其实际打算推行的政策更有用。 罗马路易斯大学国际安全分析师兼研究员沙欣·莫达雷斯（Shahin Modarres）告诉德国之声，新一轮辩论应该在铀浓缩和伊朗高浓缩铀库存谈判陷入僵局的背景下看待。 根据国际原子能机构的数据，伊朗拥有约 440 公斤（972 磅）的浓缩铀，纯度高达 60%，距离武器级 90% 的水平仅几步之遥。 2025 年 6 月美国和以色列袭击伊朗核设施后，联合国核监督机构的检查人员无法核实大部分材料的位置。 伊朗已经...

While nations often use the threat of weaponry as leverage in earthly power struggles, the biblical vision points toward a day when the tools of destruction are repurposed for the common good. We pray for leaders to choose the...
reflection.zh: 关于《不扩散核武器条约》的辩论提醒我们，国家安全与全球安全之间存在着脆弱的平衡。虽然各国常在属世的权力斗争中将武器威胁作为筹码，但圣经的愿景指向那一天，即毁灭的工具将被重新用于造福大众。我们为领导者祈祷，愿他们在雅伟面前选择降温局势的道路，并认识到真正的安全不在于毁灭的力量，而在于对和平的承诺。

title.en: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
title.zh: 死亡的NFL球员脑部疾病“高于此前显示”

summary.en: A new study says at least one in four ex-NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had a degenerative brain disease but the true figure could be much higher.
summary.zh: 一项新研究称，2016年至2021年间去世的NFL前球员中，至少有四分之一患有退行性脑部疾病，但真实数字可能更高。

body.en:
As many as 97.7% of NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 could have had brain disease related to repeated blows to the head, a new study says.

Researchers looked at 878 former players who died during that period, with 235 having donated their brains to research.

Of those, 215 were found to have chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a degenerative brain disease which can only be diagnosed after death.

The study, published in the British Medical Journal , external , also found dementia was common among brain donors.

"We and others have shown that in NFL players, specifically, there is about a four times higher rate of death from neurodegenerative disease than the general population," said the report's lead author Daniel Daneshvar, an associate professor at Harvard Medical School.

"These findings indicate that NFL players have a higher prevalence of CTE at death than has been previously shown in multiple community based studies."

Researchers calculated a "conservative minimum" of CTE prevalence among those who died in the six-year period to be 24.5% - rising to a "maximum" 97.7%.

They have urged the NFL to take prevention measures to reduce repetitive head impacts across all levels of the sport.

"The bulk of the head impacts that these former NFL players experienced didn't occur at the NFL level," Danshvar said.

"They occurred at the collegiate level and at the high school level and in many cases the youth level. And all of those cumulative hits to the head added up to result in an increased risk."

An NFL spokesperson said: "The NFL continuously strives to make the game of football safer, including by implementing strategies to reduce concussions and head impacts.

"The NFL remains committed to ensuring that the NFL community has access to a robust - and expanding - set of resources to enhance their physical and mental well being.

"We encourage former players to utilise these resources to identify and seek treatment when they are concerned about their health."

CTE among American football players has been a growing issue in recent years. A 2011 Collective Bargaining Agreement for the NFL limited the number of contact practices.

Following a long-running class action, in 2016 the NFL agreed a $1bn (£700m) settlement with more than 5,000 former players.
body.zh: 一项新研究称，2016 年至 2021 年间死亡的 NFL 球员中，多达 97.7% 的人可能患有与头部反复受到打击相关的脑部疾病。 研究人员调查了在此期间去世的 878 名前球员，其中 235 人捐献了大脑用于研究。 其中 215 人被发现患有慢性创伤性脑病 (CTE)，这是一种只能在死后才能诊断的退行性脑部疾病。 这项发表在《英国医学杂志》外部的研究还发现，痴呆症在大脑捐赠者中很常见。 该报告的主要作者、哈佛医学院副教授 Daniel Daneshvar 表示：“我们和其他人已经证明，在 NFL 球员中，神经退行性疾病的死亡率比普通人群高出四倍左右。” “这些发现表明 NFL 球员死亡时 CTE 的患病率比之前多项基于社区的研究显示的要高。” 研究人员计算出，六年内死亡者的 CTE 患病率“保守最低”为 24.5%，“最高”为 97.7%。 他们敦促 NFL 采取预防措施，以减少这项运动各个级别的重复性头部撞击。 “这些前 NFL 球员所经历的大部分头部撞击并没有发生在 NFL 级别，”丹什瓦尔说。 “这些事件发生在大学和高中，在很多情况下发生在青少年。所有这些对头部的累积打击加起来导致风险增加。” NFL 发言人表示：“NFL 不断努力让橄榄球比赛更加安全，包括实施减少脑震荡和头部撞击的策略。 “NFL 仍然致力于确保 NFL 社区能够获得强大且不断扩大的资源，以增强他们的身心健康。 “我们鼓励前球员在担心自己的健康时利用这些资源来识别并寻求治疗。” 近年来，美国橄榄球运动员的 CTE 问题日益严重。 NFL 2011 年的集体谈判协议限制了接触练习的次数。 经过长期的集体诉讼，NFL 于 2016 年与 5,000 多名前球员达成了 10 亿美元（7 亿英镑）的和解协议。

reflection.en: The human brain, "fearfully and wonderfully made," is a marvel of Yahweh's creation. This study, revealing that a high percentage of former NFL players suffered from degenerative brain disease, reminds us of the profound vulnerability of even our most complex organs. It calls us to reflect on the preciousness of the body and the long-term consequences of...
reflection.zh: 人脑是雅伟创造的奇迹，是“受造奇妙可畏”的。这项研究揭示了高比例的NFL前球员患有退行性脑部疾病，提醒我们即使是最复杂的器官也极其脆弱。它呼吁我们反思身体的宝贵，以及某些活动可能带来的长期风险。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
title.zh: 洛克比空难审判在开庭前几天被推迟

summary.en: The trial of a Libyan man is delayed for a third time, after new evidence on the 37-year-old case came to light three days ago.
summary.zh: 一名利比亚男子的审判第三次被推迟，此前关于这起37年前案件的新证据于三天前浮出水面。

body.en:
The trial of a Libyan man over the Lockerbie bombing has been postponed for a third time, after new evidence on the 37-year-old case came to light three days ago.

Jury selection was due to get under way in Washington DC on Wednesday but the BBC understands a new start date has been set for January next year.

Lawyers acting for Abu Agila Mas'ud Kheir Al-Marimi said "newly discovered evidence" previously unknown to the defence and prosecutors from the US government emerged on Friday 21 August.

Al-Marimi has denied building the bomb that destroyed Pan Am Flight 103 on 21 December 1988, killing 270 people.

His lawyers told the court: "Constitutional and ethical obligations require the defence to investigate this development."

They said they met Al-Marimi on Sunday and he agreed that they should ask for the postponement.

The trial judge, Dabney Friedrich, has agreed that the start date should be set aside, underlining the potential importance of the new evidence.

She would have been extremely reluctant to allow an 11th hour postponement after months of preparation and marathon pre-trial legal battles.

For the relatives of those who died and Al-Marimi himself, this latest delay means a verdict might not come until next spring.

It is yet another stunning development in a saga that has witnessed countless twists and turns over nearly four decades.

Pan Am 103 was flying from Heathrow to New York when the bomb exploded in its forward hold, breaking the plane apart at 31,000 feet.

All 259 passengers and crew on board were killed. Another 11 people died in Lockerbie when the wreckage fell on their homes.

Nearly four decades later, the bombing remains the worst terror attack and mass murder in British history.

Al-Marimi has been in US custody since 2022 and was originally due to stand trial in May 2025.

That date was set aside following a joint request from the prosecution and defence, who cited the complexity of the case and Al-Marimi's ill health.

The trial was pencilled in for April this year but was called off again, after the defence asked for more time to prepare.

The Lockerbie bombing has been the subject of a joint Scottish-US investigation since December 1988.

Prosecutors from the Crown Office and detectives from Police Scotland were due to travel to Washington to attend the case, and Scottish witnesses were expected to be among the first to give evidence at the trial.

Laura Buchan, head of the Lockerbie investigation team at the Crown Office and Procurator Fiscal Service said: "I recognise that this adjournment will be disappointing for the families and for those who have followed this case over many years.

"As the matter remains before the court, it would not be appropriate to comment on the reasons for the adjournment.

"Although...
body.zh: 三天前，有关这起 37 年前案件的新证据曝光后，对一名利比亚男子洛克比爆炸案的审判已第三次推迟。 陪审团遴选原定于周三在华盛顿特区开始，但 BBC 获悉，新的开始日期已定于明年 1 月。 Abu Agila Mohammad Kheir Al-Marimi 的代理律师表示，美国政府的辩方和检察官此前不知道的“新发现的证据”于 8 月 21 日星期五出现。 Al-Marimi 否认制造了 1988 年 12 月 21 日摧毁泛美 103 航班、造成 270 人死亡的炸弹。 他的律师告诉法庭：“宪法和道德义务要求辩方调查这一事态发展。” 他们说他们周日会见了阿尔马里米，他同意他们应该要求推迟。 主审法官达布尼·弗里德里希 (Dabney Friedrich) 同意推迟开始日期，强调了新证据的潜在重要性。 经过数月的准备和马拉松式的审前法律斗争后，她非常不愿意允许推迟 11 个小时。 对于死者亲属和阿尔马里米本人来说，最新的延误意味着判决可能要到明年春天才能做出。 这是近四十年来经历了无数曲折的传奇故事中又一个令人惊叹的发展。 泛美 103 班机正从希思罗机场飞往纽约时，炸弹在前舱爆炸，飞机在 31,000 英尺的高度解体。 机上259名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。洛克比空难中另有 11 人因飞机残骸落在他们的房屋上而丧生。 近四十年后，这起爆炸事件仍然是英国历史上最严重的恐怖袭击和大规模谋杀。 Al-Marimi 自 2022 年以来一直被美国拘留，原定于 2025 年 5 月接受审判。 在控方和辩方的联合请求下，这一日期被搁置，控方称案件十分复杂，而且 Al-Marimi 的健康状况不佳。 该审判原定于今年四月举行，但在辩方要求更多时间准备后再次被取消。 自 1988 年 12 月以来，洛克比爆炸事件一直是苏格兰和美国联合调查的对象。 英国皇家办公室的检察官和苏格兰警察局的侦探将前往华盛顿出席此案，预计苏格兰证人将成为首批在审判中提供证据的人之一。 英国皇家办公室和检察官财政局洛克比调查小组负责人劳拉·巴肯 (Laura Buchan) 表示：“我认识到，这次休庭会让受害者家属和多年来关注此案的人感到失望。” “由于此事仍在法庭审理中，因此不宜对延期的原因发表评论。虽然...

reflection.en: After 37 years, the Lockerbie bombing trial faces another delay due to newly discovered evidence, reminding us that the pursuit of truth can be a long and arduous journey. Proverbs 18:15 speaks to the value of an intelligent heart that acquires knowledge and a wise ear that seeks it. Even decades later, the legal system continues its diligent search for all...
reflection.zh: 洛克比空难审判在37年后因新证据的出现而再次推迟，这提醒我们，寻求真相可能是一段漫长而艰辛的旅程。箴言18:15谈到有悟性的心获得知识，智慧的耳寻求知识的价值。即使在几十年后，司法系统仍在勤奋地搜寻所有可用的事实，以确保为270名受害者伸张正义。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Why Starlink won't open Vietnam's heavily censored internet
title.zh: 为什么星链无法打开越南受严密审查的网络

summary.en: Starlink has begun offering satellite internet in Vietnam, promising connectivity for remote and mountainous areas. However, analysts note that in one of Southeast Asia's most tightly controlled online environments, increased network access does not equate to greater freedom of speech as the government maintains...
summary.zh: 星链（Starlink）已开始在越南提供卫星互联网服务，承诺为偏远和山区提供网络连接。然而，分析人士指出，在东南亚审查最严厉的网络环境之一，网络接入的增加并不等同于言论自由的扩大，因为政府仍保持着严格的监管。

body.en:
Starlink promises better connectivity in remote and mountainous areas. But in one of Southeast Asia's most tightly controlled online environments, more network access doesn't mean more free speech.

Elon Musk's Starlink has begun selling satellite internet in Vietnam, bringing its high-speed service to one of the world's most tightly controlled online environments .

The satellite internet service operated by Musk's SpaceX began accepting orders from Vietnamese customers this month, with residential packages starting at around €37 ($43) a month.

Vietnam's government announced in March 2025 that it would allow SpaceX to launch Starlink on a controlled trial basis, waiving the usual restrictions on foreign ownership. The trial is capped at 600,000 subscribers and is due to run until the end of 2030.

The service is operated through Starlink Services Vietnam, a local SpaceX subsidiary established last September.

Vietnamese authorities subsequently licensed four ground gateway stations and up to 600,000 Starlink terminals for the initial rollout. The gateways allow satellite traffic to connect with terrestrial telecommunications infrastructure inside Vietnam.

Vietnam authorized the trial in March 2025 as it sought to head off threatened US trade measures over its large bilateral trade surplus.

At the time, some analysts viewed approval of Starlink, alongside tariff reductions on several US products, as part of Hanoi's effort to ease trade tensions with Washington.

Vietnam officially connected to the global internet in 1997. By the end of 2025, it had around 85.6 million internet users, equivalent to 84.2% of the population, according to government data.

Conventional internet infrastructure is already extensive. Around 85% of Vietnamese households had fiber-optic internet, while there were more than 110 million mobile broadband subscriptions, and the country's 5G network covered around 92% of the population, according to official statistics.

Starlink is relatively expensive compared to other network options, but its most obvious advantage is not in well-connected cities such as Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City but in mountainous, remote and island communities where terrestrial infrastructure remains weaker.

The Vietnamese government says Starlink could help increase internet access in remote areas, islands and places without adequate terrestrial telecommunications infrastructure.

Because satellite connections rely less on local cables and towers, they could also provide backup communications when terrestrial networks are damaged by typhoons, floods or landslides.

However, Starlink currently advertises its cheapest household plan in Vietnam at about €37 a month, while the necessary hardware starts at roughly €284.

In rural areas, where Starlink could...
body.zh: 星链承诺在偏远和山区提供更好的连接。但在东南亚控制最严格的在线环境之一，更多的网络访问并不意味着更多的言论自由。 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Starlink 已开始在越南销售卫星互联网，将其高速服务带到世界上控制最严格的在线环境之一。 马斯克旗下 SpaceX 运营的卫星互联网服务本月开始接受越南客户的订单，住宅套餐起价约为每月 37 欧元（43 美元）。 越南政府于 2025 年 3 月宣布，将允许 SpaceX 在受控试验的基础上发射 Starlink，免除通常对外国所有权的限制。该试验的订阅人数上限为 600,000 名，并将持续到 2030 年底。 该服务由 Starlink Services Vietnam 运营，该服务是 SpaceX 去年 9 月成立的当地子公司。 越南当局随后向四个地面网关站和多达 600,000 个星链终端颁发了许可证，用于初步部署。这些网关允许卫星流量与越南境内的地面电信基础设施连接。 越南于 2025 年 3 月批准了这项审判，旨在阻止美国对其巨额双边贸易顺差采取贸易措施的威胁。 当时，一些分析人士认为，星链的批准以及对几种美国产品的关税削减，是河内缓解与华盛顿贸易紧张局势的努力的一部分。 越南于1997年正式接入全球互联网。根据政府数据，截至2025年底，越南拥有约8560万互联网用户，相当于总人口的84.2%。 传统的互联网基础设施已经非常广泛。据官方统计，约85%的越南家庭拥有光纤互联网，移动宽带用户超过1.1亿，该国5G网络覆盖约92%的人口。 与其他网络选项相比，星链相对昂贵，但其最明显的优势不是在河内或胡志明市等交通便利的城市，而是在地面基础设施仍然薄弱的山区、偏远和岛屿社区。 越南政府表示，星链可以帮助增加偏远地区、岛屿和没有足够地面电信基础设施的地方的互联网接入。 由于卫星连接对当地电缆和塔的依赖较少，因此当地面网络因台风、洪水或山体滑坡而损坏时，它们还可以提供备用通信。 然而，Starlink 目前在越南宣传其最便宜的家庭计划，价格约为每月 37 欧元，而必要的硬件起价约为 284 欧元。 在农村地区，星链可以...

reflection.en: The arrival of Starlink in Vietnam highlights a modern paradox: we can bridge the physical gap of connectivity without closing the moral gap of censorship. While high-speed satellites can reach the most remote mountains, they cannot by themselves dismantle the barriers to truth and free expression. We are reminded that the flourishing of a society depends...

title.en: Trump's visa crackdown plan could affect thousands seeking asylum in the US
title.zh: 特朗普的签证打击计划可能影响数千名在美国寻求庇护者

summary.en: The US state department has declined to comment on the number of visas that may be revoked.
summary.zh: 美国国务院拒绝就可能被吊销的签证数量发表评论。

body.en:
The Trump administration is preparing to revoke the business and tourism visas of up to 200,000 foreigners who have applied for or are currently seeking asylum status in the United States.

If it happens, the move would be the largest single mass revocation of visas in US history and would likely face legal challenges.

Unless challenged or revised, the US state department is expected to announce in the coming weeks the revocation of so-called B1 and B2 visas issued between 2016 and 2026 whose holders have sought asylum or are now seeking asylum, according to state department documents obtained by the Associated Press (AP) and two US officials. The action will be taken in coordination with the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

"We are coordinating with DHS to identify and revoke the nonimmigrant visas of foreigners who have come to the United States claiming to be short-term visitors, but then file for asylum to stay here permanently," state department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said.

He declined to comment on the number of visas that might be revoked, saying "as the process will be ongoing, the number of revocations remains dynamic and will be done on a rolling basis".

The revocations would not necessarily result in their immediate deportation, the officials said. Most of those with asylum cases currently pending would be recategorised but would lose their status as business or tourism travellers, according to the officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the revocations are not final yet.

Since US President Donald Trump took office for his second term last year, his administration has steadily ramped up restrictions on visa applicants — demanding more information about their social media histories, requiring the posting of expensive bonds to process visas, and outright banning the issuance of visas to citizens of certain countries.

In a social media post on Tuesday, US deputy secretary of state Christopher Landau called out people who he said try to use tourist and business visas to get into the US and then apply for asylum.

"People in the US and all over the world are fed up with bogus asylum claims," Landau said in a post on X. "Asylum isn’t supposed to be a loophole to circumvent immigration law."

Landau cited the case of a Colombian citizen who came to the US in 2015 on a tourist visa and then applied for asylum.

B1 visas are generally issued for business trips and B2 visas are generally issued for tourism, family visits or medical care. It was not immediately clear from the documents or the officials how many of these visa holders are seeking or have sought asylum in...

title.en: 'Economic asphyxiation': US unveils sweeping new sanctions campaign in attempt to isolate Iran
title.zh: “经济窒息”: 美国公布全面新制裁，试图孤立伊朗

summary.en: The United States has announced a new campaign of sweeping sanctions against Iran, aiming for 'economic asphyxiation' to isolate the nation. This move comes six months into a war that has seen peace talks stall and the crucial Strait of Hormuz blocked.
summary.zh: 美国宣布对伊朗实施一项新的全面制裁行动，旨在通过“经济窒息”来孤立该国。此举发生在一场持续六个月的战争中，这场战争导致和平谈判陷入僵局，并阻塞了重要的霍尔木兹海峡。

body.en:
United States treasury secretary Scott Bessent has laid out plans for the "economic asphyxiation" of Iran, expanding the US' secondary sanctions threats and warning of dire consequences for countries that do not join the campaign.

The announcement on Tuesday came almost six months into a war on Iran that has ground to a stalemate, with stalled peace talks and Iran blocking most traffic through the crucial Strait of Hormuz .

Bessent earlier said the US was declaring an "economic D-Day" on Iran, but his announcement named no specific countries beyond Iran and gave no timelines.

"Around the globe, our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone," Bessent told journalists.

"We are going to hold everyone accountable, and this is economic asphyxiation of this regime."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

He added that countries not joining US sanctions would "share in the isolation" of Iran, and noted that US President Donald Trump was making phone calls to world leaders requesting they stop interactions with Iran.

The US treasury department said expanded secondary sanctions would target Iran's digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping sectors.

It also issued new sanctions against 60 individuals, companies and vessels that allegedly aid Iran in oil revenue generation, weapons procurement and cyber operations.

The sanctions hit entities around the world, including in the United Arab Emirates, Hong Kong, China, Singapore and in Europe.

Bessent vowed that any entity "that facilitates money laundering on behalf of Iran will be removed from the US dollar system".

Iran had been dismissive of the threat of additional sanctions, and on Tuesday its economy minister predicted "another defeat" for the US on the economic front.

"We've been waiting for these plans for a long time, and the government is and was ready and has a two-year plan to manage these events," Ali Madanizadeh said.

In a post before the announcement, Iran's deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi said the latest US threats were an admission of military defeat.

Gharibabadi asked why, if the US had achieved its goals, "there is a need for 'the largest financial invasion in history' and the mobilization of 'all institutions and powers' of the United States!

Iran has weathered decades of crushing international sanctions, and before the war it continued to export millions of barrels of oil, mostly to China, and to evade sanctions through complex international financial networks.

title.en: Eurovision faces fresh scrutiny as the Netherlands withdraws over Gaza tensions
title.zh: 欧洲歌唱大赛因加沙紧张局势导致荷兰退出而面临新的审查

summary.en: The Netherlands has announced its withdrawal from next year's Eurovision Song Contest, citing that the event can no longer be considered neutral due to deep divisions over the Gaza war. The broadcaster stated that international conflicts are increasingly undermining the contest's neutral character, turning it into a...
summary.zh: 荷兰宣布退出明年的欧洲歌唱大赛，理由是鉴于加沙战争引发的深刻分歧，该赛事已无法保持中立。荷兰广播公司表示，国际冲突日益削弱了比赛的中立性，使其成为一个分裂的平台。

body.en:
The Netherlands will not participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest, its broadcaster said on Monday, saying the event can "no longer be considered neutral" given divisions over the Gaza war.

"It is undeniable that international conflicts are increasingly affecting the Contest, undermining its neutral character. The Eurovision Song Contest has therefore become a platform for division," Taco Zimmerman, director-general of AVROTROS, said in a statement from the broadcaster.

The contest has recently been hit by a wave of boycotts over Israel's participation.

Earlier this month, organisers announced they were excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition.

"However, the recently announced changes ... do not provide sufficient confidence that the independent and neutral character of the Eurovision Song Contest has been restored," the AVROTROS statement said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Israel came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion.

Next year's event, the world's biggest live televised music event, will take place on 15 May in Bulgaria's Black Sea city of Burgas.

It will be the first time that the Balkan nation hosts the contest, coming after Bulgarian singer Darina Yotova, known as Dara, won this year's contest in the Austrian capital Vienna with the catchy floor-filler "Bangaranga".

Since its launch in 1955, Eurovision has become the ultimate pop platform, catapulting Swedish icons ABBA to worldwide fame, as well as boosting the likes of Celine Dion, Cliff Richard and Olivia Newton-John.

The 2026 competition was watched by 131 million viewers, down 35 million on the year before after five countries boycotted it over Israel's participation.

The Netherlands, Iceland, Spain, Ireland and Slovenia all pulled out of the contest — with the latter three refusing to broadcast the show at all.

The Dutch took part in the very first Eurovision Song Contest back in 1956, and have won on five occasions.

The most recent winner was Duncan Laurence, whose song Arcade won the contest in 2019, going on to top charts globally.

It became the first Eurovision entry to reach one billion streams on Spotify, according to the Eurovision website.

The withdrawal is "painful as we would have very much liked to be part of the Contest again next year," Zimmerman said.

"As a public broadcaster, we remain committed to our values. They guide us in everything we do, even when that means stepping away from an event that is very close to our hearts," he added.

title.en: The challenge brewing behind the front lines in Ukraine
title.zh: 泽连斯基不希望乌克兰面临的“海啸”

summary.en: Ukraine hasn't held elections since Russia's full-scale invasion, but tensions have been brewing over the issue. President Zelenskyy has rebuffed calls for wartime elections, stating they would be a "tsunami for the state" and "split Ukraine."
summary.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵以来，乌克兰一直没有举行选举，但围绕这一问题，紧张局势一直在酝酿。泽连斯基总统拒绝了战时选举的呼吁，称这将是“国家的灾难海啸”，并会“分裂乌克兰”。

body.en:
More than four years after Russia launched the full-scale invasion that has devastated Ukraine and claimed hundreds of thousands of lives, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is facing a new political challenge: whether to hold elections during wartime.

The issue emerged last week after former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov , who was recently dismissed from his role, called for Zelenskyy to find a way to hold elections while fighting was ongoing.

The move was seen as the biggest challenge to Zelenskyy's leadership since the invasion began in February 2022, with Zelenskyy rebuffing calls for a wartime election.

"Elections right now are a tsunami for the state, which will split Ukraine," he said on Sunday, local time.

"That's why my strategy is to steer the country toward an ending of the war and to preserve an independent and sovereign state."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

National elections have been suspended since the invasion began and polling shows most Ukrainians support delaying a vote until the fighting ends.

Zelenskyy won Ukraine's 2019 presidential election in a landslide and would have ordinarily served a five-year term.

After Russia launched its full-scale invasion, Ukraine introduced martial law, which suspends some civil liberties, including national elections.

Zelenskyy's presidential term expired in 2024, but he remained in office as Ukraine's constitutional and legal system provides for continuity of government during martial law. The country's parliament has also continued operating.

Fighting continues along a front line stretching more than 1,200km, while Ukrainian cities, including the capital Kyiv, remain under regular bombardment from Russian drones and missiles.

An election would potentially require millions of Ukrainians to travel to polling stations, creating security risks and raising concerns about how voting could be conducted safely.

Political parties would also need to campaign while the country remained under attack, while authorities would have to find a way for hundreds of thousands of soldiers serving on the front line to vote.

As of the end of June, more than 4.4 million Ukrainians had temporary protection status in the European Union, meaning Ukraine would have to organise hundreds of polling stations across Europe.

Nearly four million Ukrainians have also been internally displaced, making voter registration more difficult and potentially diverting resources from the war effort.

Then there are those living under Russian occupation unable to vote. Ukrainian officials estimated that, as of 2024, around 4.5 million adult Ukrainians remained in Russian-occupied territory.

body.zh: 俄罗斯发动全面入侵，摧毁了乌克兰并夺走了数十万人的生命，四年多后，乌克兰总统泽连斯基面临着新的政治挑战：是否在战时举行选举。 上周，最近被免职的前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫呼吁泽伦斯基找到在战斗仍在进行时举行选举的方法，此后这个问题出现了。 此举被视为自 2022 年 2 月入侵开始以来对泽伦斯基领导层的最大挑战，泽伦斯基拒绝了进行战时选举的呼吁。 “现在的选举对国家来说就像一场海啸，这将分裂乌克兰，”他在当地时间周日表示。 “这就是为什么我的战略是引导国家结束战争并维护一个独立和主权的国家。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自入侵开始以来，全国选举一直暂停，民调显示大多数乌克兰人支持推迟投票直至战斗结束。 泽连斯基以压倒性优势赢得乌克兰 2019 年总统选举，任期通常为五年。 俄罗斯发动全面入侵后，乌克兰实施了戒严令，暂停了一些公民自由，包括全国选举。 泽连斯基的总统任期于 2024 年届满，但由于乌克兰宪法和法律制度规定戒严期间政府的连续性，他仍留任。该国议会也继续运作。 战斗在绵延 1,200 多公里的前线继续进行，而包括首都基辅在内的乌克兰城市仍经常受到俄罗斯无人机和导弹的轰炸。 选举可能需要数百万乌克兰人前往投票站，这会带来安全风险，并引发人们对如何安全进行投票的担忧。 政党还需要在国家仍然受到攻击的情况下开展竞选活动，而当局则必须找到一种方式让数十万在前线服役的士兵投票。 截至6月底，超过440万乌克兰人在欧盟拥有临时保护身份，这意味着乌克兰将不得不在欧洲各地组织数百个投票站。 近四百万乌克兰人也在国内流离失所，这使得选民登记更加困难，并可能转移战争资源。 还有一些生活在俄罗斯占领下的人无法投票。乌克兰官员估计，截至 2024 年，约有 450 万成年乌克兰人仍留在俄罗斯占领的领土上。 俄罗斯控制...

title.en: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
title.zh: 中国抨击美国对伊朗及其贸易伙伴实施的“非法”新制裁

summary.en: The US has announced new economic sanctions targeting Iran and its trading partners, including China, threatening to isolate nations that continue business with Tehran. China's foreign ministry spokesman, Lin Jian, stated firm opposition to these "illegal unilateral sanctions" and vowed to take "all necessary...
summary.zh: 美国宣布对伊朗及其贸易伙伴（包括中国）实施新的经济制裁，并威胁要孤立那些继续与德黑兰进行贸易的国家。中国外交部发言人林剑表示，中方坚决反对这些“非法单边制裁”，并誓言将采取“一切必要措施”维护自身权益。中国目前是伊朗石油的最大买家。

body.en:
China has vowed to protect its interests after the US announced plans to widen economic sanctions against Iran and its trading partners, which include Beijing.

Foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian said China was firmly opposed to what it called "illegal unilateral sanctions" and would take "all necessary measures" to safeguard its rights.

This came after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the new measures on Monday, warning any nation financially partnering with Iran would be isolated.

China is the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, although the trade has declined under the US blockade of Iran's ports.

Lin said: "Cooperation between China and Iran has always been conducted within the framework of international law and should not be interfered with or disrupted."

Bessent described the plans for sanctions as "the single greatest financial offensive ever" against Iran, warning banks and businesses would share in Iran's isolation if they refused to cut ties with the country.

He declined to focus on specific nations, but said US President Donald Trump would be phoning world leaders "with specific requests to cease their interactions with the regime".

However, responding to a question about Chinese banks, Bessent said he wanted to make clear "no one was above the reach of US sanctions".

The announcement comes ahead of planned talks between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping next month.

Washington is likely to be wary of potential retaliation from Beijing, which processes the majority of the world's rare earths and other critical minerals, crucial in the manufacture of many high-tech products.

Beijing has already tightened export controls on rare earths as part of previous trade negotiations with the US.

China's response followed Iranian Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh saying Tehran was "fully prepared" for the wider sanctions, which he said would lead to "another defeat" for the US.

"The government is and was ready and has a two-year plan to manage these events," he told state television.

"We also have our own tools and know how to play the game," he said, adding Tehran had been "waiting for these plans for a long time".

The US has dubbed its latest sanctions "Operation Economic Outcast" and described them as an "economic D-Day" against Iran.

The conflict has since led to hikes in oil prices worldwide, with Tehran effectively blocking exports through the Strait of Hormuz - a waterway vital to the global economy. The US has also slowed traffic via its own naval blockade.

Recent attempts to end the conflict via diplomacy have failed, and a 60-day ceasefire formally expired last week with no sign of a settlement.

With the announcement of new sanctions, the US treasury secretary claimed America was "no longer managing the Iranian...
body.zh: 在美国宣布计划扩大对伊朗及其包括北京在内的贸易伙伴的经济制裁后，中国发誓要保护自己的利益。 外交部发言人林坚表示，中方坚决反对所谓的“非法单边制裁”，并将采取“一切必要措施”维护自身权利。 此前，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周一宣布了新措施，警告任何与伊朗进行金融合作的国家都将被孤立。 中国是伊朗石油的最大买家，尽管在美国封锁伊朗港口的情况下贸易有所下降。 林说：“中伊合作始终在国际法框架内进行，不应受到干扰和破坏。” 贝森特将制裁计划描述为针对伊朗的“有史以来最大规模的金融攻势”，并警告说，如果银行和企业拒绝切断与伊朗的联系，它们将遭受伊朗的孤立。 他拒绝关注具体国家，但表示美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将致电世界领导人，“提出停止与该政权互动的具体要求”。 然而，在回答有关中资银行的问题时，贝森特表示，他想明确表示“没有人能逃脱美国制裁的范围”。 这一消息是在特朗普与中国国家主席习近平计划下个月举行会谈之前宣布的。 华盛顿可能会对北京方面可能采取的报复行动保持警惕，因为中国加工了世界上大部分稀土和其他关键矿物，这些矿物对于许多高科技产品的制造至关重要。 作为此前与美国贸易谈判的一部分，北京已经收紧了稀土出口管制。 伊朗经济部长阿里·马达尼扎德表示，德黑兰已为更广泛的制裁“做好充分准备”，他表示，这将导致美国“又一次失败”。 他对国家电视台表示：“政府已经做好准备，并制定了两年计划来管理这些事件。” “我们也有自己的工具，并且知道如何玩这个游戏，”他说，并补充说德黑兰已经“等待这些计划很长时间了”。 美国将其最新制裁称为“经济放逐行动”，并将其描述为针对伊朗的“经济诺曼底登陆”。 此后，冲突导致全球石油价格上涨，德黑兰实际上封锁了对全球经济至关重要的霍尔木兹海峡的出口。美国还通过自己的海上封锁减缓了交通。 最近通过外交手段结束冲突的尝试均以失败告终，60 天的停火协议于上周正式到期，且没有任何解决的迹象。 随着新制裁的宣布，美国财政部长声称美国“不再管理伊朗......
