title.en: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
title.zh: 中国机器人革命：超越人形，静默的变革正在发生

summary.en: China is experiencing a rapid expansion of industrial robots in its factories, with over two million currently in operation. Educational institutions are adapting quickly, with instructors like Chen teaching college students about artificial intelligence and robotics, including programming industrial robots and...
summary.zh: 中国正在经历工厂工业机器人的快速扩张，目前已有超过两百万台投入使用。教育机构也在迅速适应，陈老师等教育者正在教授大学生人工智能和机器人技术，包括编程工业机器人和开发医疗仪器。

body.en:
His world certainly does. The 28-year-old keeps up with the latest technology by spending his spare time in factories that are switching to automation. That way he knows what to prioritise when teaching his class about artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics.

In front of him, around 30 college students are studying code. One of them is typing furiously as his eyes dart from the screen to the robot: "The idea is it will grab that cylindrical piece and move it over there."

A line of industrial robots are waiting to be programmed, and in another part of the classroom, students are trying to develop robotic medical instruments. As he guides them, Chen declares: "If you are not needed by the world of AI and robotics, then you'll definitely be among those eliminated".

For the people in this room, this is a step - or rather a leap - towards a future that China is meticulously building: Xi Jinping's $20bn (£14.7bn) plan to put his country at the forefront of innovation and in direct competition with the US.

The evidence is all around them. They are in the Hangzhou Technician Institute, one of several huge, purpose-built vocational schools that want to churn out the next generation of tech-savvy engineers. The campus sits on the outskirts of Hangzhou, a former imperial capital whose futuristic skyline is just the first hint of its role as a global tech hub.

Across the country, there are more than two million robots working in China's factories - which is more than anywhere else - and they are continuing to scale up at extraordinary speed.

It is a commitment that will surely change the world, much like the last time the Chinese economy underwent a massive transformation. It is already shipping its robots across the globe: more than half of the world's industrial robots are now made in China.

What is less clear is the impact of such sweeping automation in a country that sits at the heart of global manufacturing, trade and innovation. What does this mean for China's human workforce, for instance? And how would we be able to truly measure the cost of this transformation in a regime that controls information so tightly?

The future of China's workers is uncertain in the industrial revolution the world has been watching: gleaming solar grids, peak hours made noiseless by electric vehicles, machines that run faster than Usain Bolt. Over the weekend, China hosted the second edition of the World Humanoid Games where robots boxed, sprinted and marched.

What is fuelling this spectacle is another, less visible revolution happening inside factories and classrooms.

The BBC has visited industrial sites where we have been shown robots that do not look human, or dance or leap on stage but weld, paint, lift, assemble and work around the clock without a break or...
body.zh: 他的世界确实如此。这位 28 岁的年轻人将业余时间花在正在转向自动化的工厂里，以跟上最新技术的步伐。这样，他就知道在课堂上教授人工智能 (AI) 和机器人技术时要优先考虑什么。 在他面前，大约有 30 名大学生正在学习代码。其中一个人正在疯狂地打字，他的眼睛从屏幕扫向机器人：“我们的想法是，它会抓住那个圆柱形部件并将其移到那里。” 一排工业机器人正在等待编程，在教室的另一部分，学生们正在尝试开发机器人医疗仪器。在指导他们时，陈宣称：“如果人工智能和机器人世界不需要你，那么你肯定会被淘汰”。 对于在座的人们来说，这是中国正在精心建设的未来的一步，或者说是一次飞跃：习近平斥资 200 亿美元（147 亿英镑）的计划，旨在让中国走在创新的前沿，与美国直接竞争。 证据就在他们周围。他们就读于杭州技师学院，这是几所大型的专门职业学校之一，旨在培养下一代精通技术的工程师。该园区位于前帝国首都杭州的郊区，其未来主义的天际线只是其作为全球科技中心角色的第一个迹象。 在全国范围内，有超过 200 万台机器人在中国的工厂里工作——这比其他任何地方都多——而且它们还在以惊人的速度继续扩大规模。 这是一个必将改变世界的承诺，就像上次中国经济经历巨大转型一样。它已经将其机器人运往全球：目前全球一半以上的工业机器人是在中国制造的。 不太清楚的是，如此全面的自动化对一个处于全球制造、贸易和创新中心的国家产生的影响还不太清楚。例如，这对中国的劳动力意味着什么？在一个如此严格控制信息的政权中，我们如何才能真正衡量这种转变的成本？ 在全世界都在关注的工业革命中，中国工人的未来充满不确定性：闪闪发光的太阳能电网、电动汽车让高峰时段变得无噪音、运行速度比尤塞恩·博尔特还快的机器。周末，中国主办了第二届世界人形运动会，机器人进行了拳击、短跑和行军比赛。 推动这一奇观的是工厂和教室内部发生的另一场不太明显的革命。 BBC 参观了工业现场，在那里我们看到了机器人，它们看起来不像人类，在舞台上跳舞或跳跃，但可以焊接、油漆、举升、组装和昼夜不停地工作……

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, particularly in AI and robotics as seen in China's factories and classrooms, mirrors the ancient prophecy of knowledge and understanding increasing. As we navigate this era of rapid change, may we seek wisdom to guide these powerful tools toward serving humanity and reflecting Yahweh's order.
reflection.zh: 科技的飞速发展，尤其在中国工厂和课堂中可见的人工智能和机器人技术，恰如古老的预言所言，知识和理解日益增长。当我们在这个快速变化的时代前行时，愿我们寻求智慧来引导这些强大的工具，服务于人类，并彰显雅伟的秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'Can't abstain from this debate': Pacific nations the next frontier in deep-sea mining
title.zh: “无法回避的辩论”：太平洋国家成为深海采矿的下一个前沿

summary.en: A new report warns that commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin as early as 2027, driven by increasing rivalry between the United States and China for critical minerals. Pacific nations are reportedly split between the promise of economic benefits and the risk of irreversible damage to the environment...
summary.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国之间对关键矿产的竞争日益加剧，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能最早在2027年开始。据报道，太平洋国家在经济利益的承诺与对环境和当地生计造成不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。

body.en:
Commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin in months without policy guardrails due to increasing rivalry between the United States and China over critical minerals, a new report warns.

Analysis by the Lowy Institute has found mining could start as early as 2027, with the floor of the Pacific Ocean holding vast quantities of prized resources.

The contest between the world's two biggest economies is being driven by demand created by batteries, weapons systems, and power grids.

The region's nations are split between the promise of economic spoils and the risk of irreversible damage to the ecosystem, fisheries, food security, livelihoods and culture, according to the research.

It argues the absence of an international governance framework for commercial deep-sea mining leaves Pacific states negotiating without internationally agreed protections.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

This also leaves them dependent on individual agreements drafted by companies seeking to mine their ocean floor.

"For the Pacific Island nations caught in the middle of this great power battle for critical mineral supremacy, the economic proposition is difficult to refuse," the Lowy Institute's Connor Graham writes.

"The problem is not that Pacific nations disagree, it is that they are being forced to negotiate individually against parties with vastly more resources, information, and legal capacity, and that the international framework designed to protect them has stalled."

Graham said while Australia was yet to take a clear position on deep-sea mining in the Pacific, it has the standing, relationships, and institutional presence to make an impact.

This includes its membership in the Pacific Islands Forum and as a long-standing ally of the US.

"A commitment to standards that have not been written as a condition for activity that is about to begin is less of a policy, and more of an abstention," he said.

Countries including Australia have started to enter into deals for critical minerals, which are crucial for a number for emerging technologies.

The federal government has announced a $1.2 billion critical minerals strategic reserve to secure the supply of key minerals deemed crucial for Australia's economy and national security.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国在关键矿产方面的竞争日益激烈，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能会在没有政策保护的情况下在几个月内开始。 洛伊研究所的分析发现，采矿最早可能在 2027 年开始，太平洋海底蕴藏着大量珍贵资源。 全球最大的两个经济体之间的竞争是由电池、武器系统和电网产生的需求驱动的。 研究表明，该地区各国在经济收益的承诺和生态系统、渔业、粮食安全、生计和文化遭受不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。 它认为，商业深海采矿国际治理框架的缺乏导致太平洋国家在没有国际商定保护的情况下进行谈判。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这也使得它们依赖于寻求海底采矿的公司起草的单独协议。 洛伊研究所的康纳·格雷厄姆写道：“对于陷入这场争夺关键矿产霸权的大国战争的太平洋岛国来说，这个经济提议很难拒绝。” “问题不在于太平洋国家不同意，而在于它们被迫与拥有更多资源、信息和法律能力的各方进行单独谈判，而旨在保护它们的国际框架已经陷入停滞。” 格雷厄姆表示，虽然澳大利亚尚未对太平洋深海采矿采取明确立场，但它拥有产生影响的地位、关系和机构存在。 这包括它是太平洋岛屿论坛的成员以及美国的长期盟友。 他说：“对尚未作为即将开始的活动条件的标准的承诺与其说是一项政策，不如说是一种弃权。” 包括澳大利亚在内的国家已开始签订关键矿物交易，这对许多新兴技术至关重要。 联邦政府宣布设立 12 亿美元的关键矿产战略储备，以确保对澳大利亚经济和国家安全至关重要的关键矿产的供应。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The prospect of deep-sea mining in the Pacific presents a stark choice for island nations, balancing potential economic gains against the risk of irreversible ecological damage. As the report warns of mining commencing without adequate policy guardrails, the words of 1 Corinthians 10:23 remind us that while many actions may be permissible, not all are truly...
reflection.zh: 太平洋深海采矿的前景给岛屿国家带来了严峻的选择，需要在潜在的经济收益与不可逆转的生态破坏风险之间取得平衡。正如报告警告，在缺乏充分政策保障的情况下，采矿可能即将开始，哥林多前书10:23提醒我们，虽然许多事情是合法的，但并非所有事情都有益处或能造就人。这种情况呼唤智慧，以辨别什么能真正造就社区并保护雅伟的创造，而不是仅仅追求权宜之计。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Sam was jailed for helping Hong Kong's protesters. He came home to a city in silence
title.zh: 香港镇压异见，山姆出狱后发现城市一片寂静

summary.en: Six years after China imposed the National Security Law, Hong Kong's crackdown on dissent has spread beyond its borders.
summary.zh: 中国实施《国家安全法》六年之后，香港对异见的镇压已蔓延至境外。

body.en:
Watch Dateline’s latest episode, Hong Kong: A City Silenced, on 25 August at 9.30pm AEST on SBS or SBS On Demand.

At 21, Sam Chan Chi-sum was preparing to leave Hong Kong to continue his studies overseas.

He'd been involved with a student activist group that collected sweets and toiletries to send to people jailed after Hong Kong’s 2019 anti-government protests.

Authorities accused the group of using the supplies to build support among prisoners and incite opposition to the government.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In September 2021, Sam was arrested under Hong Kong’s sweeping National Security Law, which had been passed a year earlier, and was convicted of "subversion with the intent of overthrowing the government".

"Prison was awful. I shared a cell with around twenty people. At its most crowded, there could be forty of us," he said.

He alleged some prison officers purposely mistreated inmates associated with the protest movement.

"I don't know whether they were acting out of personal conviction or following orders. But they certainly made life difficult for us."

Two years after his release from prison, Sam is trying to rebuild a normal life.

He had dreamt of becoming a teacher or a nurse, but his criminal record prevents him from pursuing either career.

"Since being released from prison, I feel as though I've entered a much larger cell," he said.

Instead, he is training to become a documentary filmmaker, determined, he says, to capture the transformation of Hong Kong.

"Whatever the outcome for Hong Kong, whether the future is good or bad, I want to stay here and witness the changes that lie ahead."

Sam’s story is like many other young Hongkongers whose lives have been upended by China’s crackdown on freedoms in Hong Kong, a city once known for its outspoken press, independent judiciary and political opposition.

In 1997, after more than 150 years of British rule, Hong Kong was handed back to China under the "one country, two systems" arrangement that promised Hong Kong would keep a high degree of autonomy.

Like Sam, Carmen Lau was from a generation that came of age after this handover to China: neither British, nor truly Chinese.

As a teenager, Carmen led a student movement in her secondary school against the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) attempt to introduce 'patriotism' lessons in Hong Kong schools.

Many Hongkongers feared it would promote the CCP’s version of patriotism in their city.

"That time was the first time that I was really involved in a social event," said Lau, who’s now 30 and lives in exile in London.

Following large demonstrations, the CCP abandoned its plans...
body.zh: 8 月 25 日晚上 9 点半（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 观看《Dateline》的最新一集《香港：一座沉默的城市》。 21岁的陈志森正准备离开香港到海外继续深造。 他曾参与一个学生活动团体，该团体收集糖果和洗漱用品，寄给香港 2019 年反政府抗议活动后入狱的人。 当局指责该组织利用这些物资在囚犯中赢得支持并煽动反对政府。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 2021年9月，Sam根据一年前通过的香港国家安全法被捕，并被判“颠覆国家政权罪”。 “监狱太糟糕了。我和大约二十个人同住一间牢房。最拥挤的时候，我们可能有四十个人，”他说。 他声称一些监狱官员故意虐待与抗议运动有关的囚犯。 “我不知道他们是出于个人信念还是奉命行事。但他们确实让我们的生活变得困难。” 出狱两年后，萨姆正在努力重建正常的生活。 他曾梦想成为一名教师或护士，但他的犯罪记录阻止了他从事这两种职业。 “自从出狱后，我感觉自己好像进入了一个更大的牢房，”他说。 相反，他正在接受培训，成为一名纪录片制片人，他说，决心捕捉香港的转变。 “无论香港的结果如何，无论未来是好还是坏，我都想留在这里，见证未来的变化。” 萨姆的故事就像许多其他香港年轻人一样，他们的生活因中国对香港自由的镇压而被打乱。这座城市曾经以其直言不讳的新闻界、独立的司法机构和政治反对派而闻名。 1997年，在英国统治150多年之后，香港在“一国两制”安排下回归中国，并承诺香港将保持高度自治。 和 Sam 一样，刘嘉敏也是中国回归后长大的一代人：既不是英国人，也不是真正的中国人。 青少年时期，卡门在中学领导了一场学生运动，反对中国共产党试图在香港学校引入“爱国主义”课程。 许多香港人担心这会在他们的城市宣扬中共版本的爱国主义。 “那次是我第一次真正参与社交活动，”现年 30 岁、流亡伦敦的刘说。 大规模示威后，中共放弃了计划……

reflection.en: The story of Sam returning to a silenced city after imprisonment highlights the profound impact of oppressive rule on a community. Yahweh's word reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a roaring lion, bringing fear and helplessness to the people. In such times, we are called to remember the dignity of every individual and pray for justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 山姆在被囚禁后回到一个寂静的城市，这个故事凸显了压迫性统治对一个社区的深远影响。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者如同咆哮的狮子，给人民带来恐惧和无助。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召要记住每个人的尊严，并为公义与和平祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Watch: Moment humanoid robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m record
title.zh: 见证时刻：人形机器人打破博尔特百米纪录

summary.en: A humanoid robot developed in Beijing has completed a 100m sprint in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's world record of 9.58 seconds. The event, held at the World Humanoid Robot Games, showcased advancements in robotics including boxing, football, and household tasks. While the robot's speed is a mechanical...
summary.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，一台人形机器人以9.39秒的成绩完成了百米冲刺，超越了尤塞恩·博尔特9.58秒的世界纪录。此次活动展示了机器人在拳击、足球和家务处理等领域的进步。虽然机器人的速度是一个机械里程碑，但它也凸显了在模仿人类体能方面飞速的技术进步。

body.en:
A robot has outperformed humans by running faster than Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record at the World Humanoid Robot Games in China.

The humanoid robot, developed by the Beijing Innovation Centre of Humanoid Robotics, ran the distance in 9.39 seconds at the event.

Eight-time Olympic gold medallist Bolt set the world record for humans in 2009, running 100m in 9.58 seconds.

The robot beat two others including one made by Chinese smartphone maker Honor - which the manufacturer says ran the distance in 9.32 seconds in a test run.

Other events at the robot games, which started on Saturday, include boxing and football, but also household tasks such as folding laundry.
body.zh: 在中国举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人跑得比尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的 1 亿米短跑世界纪录还要快，从而超越了人类。 由北京仿人机器人创新中心研发的仿人机器人在比赛中跑出了9.39秒的成绩。 八届奥运会金牌得主博尔特在 2009 年以 9.58 秒跑完 100m 的成绩创造了人类世界纪录。 该机器人击败了另外两个机器人，其中包括中国智能手机制造商荣耀制造的一个机器人，该制造商表示，该机器人在测试运行中仅用了 9.32 秒就跑完了距离。 周六开始的机器人比赛的其他项目包括拳击和足球，还有叠衣服等家务活。

reflection.en: The sight of a machine clocking 9.39 seconds in Beijing challenges our understanding of physical limits and the 'prize' of athletic achievement. While a robot can be engineered for singular mechanical efficiency, the human race involves a holistic discipline of the soul and body that reflects the wisdom of Yahweh. We celebrate human ingenuity in creating...
reflection.zh: 在北京看到机器跑出9.39秒的成绩，挑战了我们对体能极限和竞技“奖赏”的理解。虽然机器人可以为了单一的机械效率而设计，但人类的赛程包含了反映雅伟智慧的身心全面操练。我们赞叹人类创造此类工具的智慧，但我们也记得，人的终极价值不在于成为最快的“机器”。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: After two decades, China is preparing its boldest Moon mission yet
title.zh: 历经二十载，中国正筹备迄今为止最大胆的探月任务

summary.en: China's ambitious space program will take it to the moon as soon as next month, and it's looking for water.
summary.zh: 中国雄心勃勃的航天计划最早将于下月开启探月之旅，重点是寻找月球上的水源。

body.en:
How do you explore a place where the sun never shines? China's space program will soon embark on one of the most innovative lunar exploration missions in recent years.

We’ve known for nearly two decades that some form of water exists on the moon. What we still don’t know is exactly how much accessible water ice lies inside permanently shadowed craters, how deeply it is buried or what form it takes.

What we do know is that accessing that water ice will be a real challenge: it is found at the bottom of deep, hard-to-traverse craters where the sun never shines, remaining untouched for billions of years at temperatures well below –200C. These are among the most valuable places on the moon, but the hardest to reach and explore.

Lunar exploration has come a long way since the Soviet Union’s Luna-1 probe reached the moon's vicinity in January 1959. The Apollo missions and their successors showed the challenge is no longer simply to reach the moon. It is to explore places human and conventional rovers cannot easily go, and ultimately determine whether the moon itself can provide some of the resources that future explorers will need.

China has spent two decades building an increasingly ambitious lunar exploration program, named after Chang'e, the ancient Chinese goddess of the moon. The Chang'e-7 mission is expected to set course for our celestial neighbour later this month, although a recent failure involving a different Chinese rocket has introduced some uncertainty over the launch date. Here’s what makes this latest mission so interesting.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The mission will test several novel approaches to lunar exploration. It will consist of an orbiter, a lander, a rover and a hopper.

In addition, the Queqiao-2 lunar relay satellite is already in place. Launched separately in March 2024, it subsequently supported the Chang'e-6 mission and will facilitate communication between Earth and the lunar surface during the Chang'e-7 mission.

We don’t know precisely where the mission will land, but a site on or near an illuminated ridge close to the Shackleton crater in the Lunar South Pole’s Aitken region is a prime candidate.

The hopper will be the mission’s real star. Unlike a wheeled rover, it’s designed to leap over broken terrain and descend into craters where sunlight never reaches, places conventional vehicles may simply be unable to enter.

Adding it to the mission makes sense, given the steep crater walls, broken terrain, permanent shadow and the need for autonomous navigation and communications.

Chinese scientists won’t be looking for signs of water; we...
body.zh: 如何探索一个阳光照不到的地方？中国的太空计划很快将启动近年来最具创新性的月球探测任务之一。 近二十年来，我们已经知道月球上存在某种形式的水。我们仍然不知道的是，在永久阴影的陨石坑内到底有多少可接近的水冰，它埋藏的深度有多深，或者它的形式是什么。 我们所知道的是，获取这些水冰将是一个真正的挑战：它是在难以穿越的深坑底部发现的，那里的阳光永远不会照射到，在远低于零下200摄氏度的温度下数十亿年都保持不变。这些是月球上最有价值的地方，但也是最难到达和探索的地方。 自 1959 年 1 月苏联的 Luna-1 探测器到达月球附近以来，月球探索已经取得了长足的进步。阿波罗任务及其后续任务表明，挑战不再仅仅是到达月球。它是为了探索人类和传统漫游车无法轻易到达的地方，并最终确定月球本身是否可以提供未来探险者所需的一些资源。 中国花了二十年的时间制定了一项日益雄心勃勃的月球探测计划，该计划以中国古代月亮女神嫦娥的名字命名。嫦娥七号任务预计将于本月晚些时候飞往我们的天体邻居，尽管最近另一枚中国火箭的失败给发射日期带来了一些不确定性。这就是这个最新任务如此有趣的原因。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该任务将测试几种月球探索的新方法。它将由轨道飞行器、着陆器、漫游车和漏斗组成。 此外，鹊桥二号月球中继卫星也已就位。它于2024年3月单独发射，随后支持嫦娥六号任务，并将在嫦娥七号任务期间促进地球与月球表面之间的通信。 我们不知道任务将在哪里着陆，但月球南极艾特肯地区靠近沙克尔顿陨石坑的照明山脊上或附近的一个地点是主要候选地点。 漏斗将成为这次任务的真正明星。与轮式漫游车不同，它的设计目的是跳过破碎的地形并下降到阳光永远无法到达的陨石坑中，而传统车辆可能根本无法进入这些地方。 考虑到陡峭的火山口壁、破碎的地形、永久的阴影以及自主导航和通信的需求，将其添加到任务中是有意义的。 中国科学家不会寻找水的迹象；而是寻找水的迹象。我们...

As researchers seek to understand what has remained untouched for billions of years, we see the dignity of the scientific pursuit. This mission reminds us that searching out the...

title.en: NSW’s koala national park will protect threatened species and cap logging across the state. Could the Greens really block it? | Adam Morton

summary.en: The Albanese government approved a proposal allowing the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars, sparking a schism among environmentalists What qualifies as a win in environmental campaigning? Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of threatened species, including koalas, and has been the focus of years and years of campaigning, is protected from logging?

Or does it depend on how the battle is won – for example, if it lets companies claim that the forest is helping cut their pollution?

It sounds like the start of a philosophical debate, but isn’t. It’s at the heart of a dispute dividing environment and climate activists, and is being weighed by the Greens ahead of a vote in the Senate next month.

In blunt terms, the minor party is considering whether to make an extraordinary call: to support a Nationals motion to strike down a Labor plan that would create a long-discussed great koala national park in northern New South Wales, and significantly reduce native forest logging in the state.

The vote was scheduled for last week but – in a sign of how vexed the issue has become – has been delayed until next month after the Greens asked the Nationals for more time to reach a consensus position.

In terms of a national political debate, the issue hasn’t had much of a look-in yet. But the ramifications could be substantial.

The story starts with a grassroots campaign to create a large park around Coffs Harbour to protect forests and more than a hundred threatened species, including koalas, gliders and glossy black cockatoos. That campaign is backed by a range of local campaigners and First Nations leaders.

NSW Labor signed up as a supporter more than a decade ago while in opposition. Under the premier, Chris Minns , it wasn’t until September 2025 that it announced it would add 176,000 hectares of state forest – an area more than twice the size of Canberra – to existing protected areas to create a 476,000 hectare reserve. It is said to protect about 12,000 koalas, water catchments and carbon stores.

The final confirmation that the park would go ahead didn’t come until June , when the Albanese government approved a NSW proposal that allows it to use the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

Carbon credits remain opaque to most people, but they are the centre of the Australian government’s climate change policy. We need to explain why (bear with me here).

Each credit is said to represent one tonne of greenhouse gas emissions that has been prevented or drawn down from the atmosphere. In Australia, they most often come from projects that are meant to regenerate forests in the outback and capture and burn methane released from landfill sites.

The goal of the projects is sound. Regenerating forests is good! Cutting methane pollution is good! But the projects themselves have been sharply criticised.

Scientific studies have found major shortcomings with the main types of projects used in Australia and...
body.zh: 是不是当一片巨大的森林地区受到保护，免遭砍伐时，这里栖息着包括考拉在内的许多受威胁物种，并且多年来一直是运动的焦点？ 还是取决于这场战斗如何获胜——例如，是否可以让公司声称森林正在帮助减少污染？ 这听起来像是一场哲学辩论的开始，但事实并非如此。这是环境和气候活动人士之间争论的核心，绿党在下个月参议院投票之前正在权衡这一问题。 坦白说，这个小党正在考虑是否发出特别呼吁：支持国家党一项动议，否决一项工党计划，该计划将在新南威尔士州北部建立一个讨论已久的大考拉国家公园，并大幅减少该州的原生森林采伐。 投票原定于上周举行，但在绿党要求国民队有更多时间达成共识后，投票被推迟到下个月，这表明这个问题已经变得多么棘手。 就全国政治辩论而言，这个问题还没有得到太多关注。但其影响可能是巨大的。 故事始于一场草根运动，旨在在科夫斯港周围创建一个大型公园，以保护森林和一百多种受威胁的物种，包括考拉、滑翔机和光泽的黑色凤头鹦鹉。该活动得到了一系列当地活动人士和原住民领导人的支持。 新南威尔士州工党十多年前在反对党时期就加入了支持者行列。在州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 的领导下，直到 2025 年 9 月，澳大利亚才宣布将在现有保护区的基础上增加 176,000 公顷的国家森林（面积是堪培拉面积的两倍多），以创建 476,000 公顷的保护区。据说它可以保护大约 12,000 只考拉、集水区和碳储存。 直到六月，阿尔巴尼亚政府才最终确认该公园将继续建设，当时阿尔巴尼亚政府批准了新南威尔士州的一项提案，允许其利用该公园创造价值数亿澳元的碳信用额。 碳信用额对大多数人来说仍然不透明，但它们是澳大利亚政府气候变化政策的核心。我们需要解释一下原因（请耐心听我说）。 据说每个信用额代表已被阻止或从大气中减少的一吨温室气体排放量。在澳大利亚，它们通常来自旨在再生内陆森林并捕获和燃烧垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷的项目。 这些项目的目标是合理的。恢复森林是好事！减少甲烷污染是好事！但这些项目本身却遭到了严厉批评。 科学研究发现澳大利亚使用的主要项目类型存在重大缺陷......

title.en: Sean wanted to raise his son here. Then came the 'massive black box'
title.zh: 肖恩想在这里抚养儿子，直到那个“巨大的黑匣子”出现

summary.en: Residents in West Footscray, Melbourne, are reporting significant disruptions from a newly constructed NextDC data center located 300 meters from residential homes. The facility brings constant humming noise and light pollution, leading to calls for better planning protections for existing communities.
summary.zh: 墨尔本西富茨克雷的居民反映，距离住宅区仅300米的新建 NextDC 数据中心造成了严重干扰。该设施带来了持续的嗡嗡声和光污染，引发了人们呼吁为现有社区提供更好的规划保护。

body.en:
When Sean Brown moved to West Footscray two years ago, days after his son was born, he thought he'd found a good spot to raise a family — green space, a train station nearby, and a community with room to grow.

Instead, his home is now 300 metres from one of the largest data centres in the country.

"It's a massive black box in the middle of a residential area. There's this visual heaviness to it that you can't really escape," Brown tells SBS News.

NextDC's M3 facility in the Melbourne suburb brings a constant humming noise audible even 100m away, he says, while ongoing construction means near-constant light, noise and disruption.

Parking is scarce with facility workers competing for street spots, and Brown says whole streets have lost power for full days at a time during infrastructure works, with little warning and no compensation. He's also worried about health risks, and the future of his entire suburb.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Branded by its chief executive, Craig Scroggie, as "Australia's largest hyperscale AI factory", the M3 site is set to double in size by 2027 — covering 10 hectares in size, and drawing 225MW of power, 24 hours a day.

A separate facility, the Perri Melbourne Data Centre (PMDC), has been approved and planned just a few blocks over.

There are currently 162 operational data centres across Australia, with a further 90 proposed, according to the Climate Council — and it's unclear whether planned rules to data centres in residential areas will apply to any of them.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will use a speech to the Business Council of Australia's annual dinner on Tuesday night to announce new national rules that would block future data centres from being built near homes, schools, or prime agricultural land.

Developers will also be required to add more renewable energy to the grid than their data centres consume, minimise water use, and ensure new sites are appropriate for their size — avoiding land that could otherwise be used for housing.

"Australia is in a strong position to attract investment in data centres, but maintaining social licence will be essential," Albanese will say.

"That means ensuring energy bills do not rise, water security is maintained and locations are appropriate."

Asked about communities already living with data centres, Albanese did not directly answer when pressed on ABC Perth on Tuesday, instead pointing to the same social licence framework.

Asked by SBS News whether any measures would target existing sites or address community concern that the new rules don't cover people already affected, the prime minister's office declined to comment.

body.zh: 两年前，当肖恩·布朗搬到西富茨克雷时，也就是他儿子出生几天后，他认为自己找到了一个养家糊口的好地方——绿地、附近的火车站和一个有成长空间的社区。 相反，他的家现在距离该国最大的数据中心之一只有 300 米。 “这是一个位于住宅区中央的巨大黑匣子。它给人一种视觉上的沉重感，你无法真正逃脱，”布朗告诉 SBS 新闻。 他说，NextDC 位于墨尔本郊区的 M3 设施发出持续的嗡嗡声，即使在 100m 之外也能听到，而正在进行的施工意味着几乎持续不断的光线、噪音和干扰。 由于设施工作人员争夺街道停车位，停车位稀缺，布朗表示，在基础设施施工期间，整条街道一度停电一整天，几乎没有任何警告，也没有任何补偿。他还担心健康风险以及整个郊区的未来。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 M3 工厂的首席执行官 Craig Scroggie 称其为“澳大利亚最大的超大规模人工智能工厂”，到 2027 年，其规模将扩大一倍——占地 10 公顷，每天 24 小时提供 225 兆瓦的电力。 一个单独的设施，即佩里墨尔本数据中心 (PMDC)，已在几个街区之外获得批准和规划。 根据气候理事会的数据，澳大利亚目前有 162 个正在运营的数据中心，并计划再建设 90 个数据中心，目前尚不清楚计划中的住宅区数据中心规则是否适用于其中任何一个数据中心。 澳大利亚总理安东尼·艾博内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 将于周二晚上在澳大利亚商业委员会年度晚宴上发表讲话，宣布新的国家规定，禁止未来的数据中心建在住宅、学校或主要农田附近。 开发商还需要向电网添加比数据中心消耗的更多的可再生能源，最大限度地减少用水，并确保新场地适合其规模，避免使用本来可以用于住房的土地。 阿尔巴尼斯表示：“澳大利亚在吸引数据中心投资方面处于有利地位，但维持社会许可至关重要。” “这意味着确保能源费用不上涨、维持水安全以及地点合适。” 周二，当被问及已经拥有数据中心的社区时，阿尔巴尼斯在接受澳大利亚广播公司珀斯 (ABC Perth) 采访时没有直接回答，而是指出了相同的社会许可框架。 当被 SBS 新闻问及是否有任何措施针对现有场所或解决社区对新规则不涵盖已经受影响的人的担忧时，总理办公室拒绝发表评论。 尽管...

reflection.en: Sean Brown’s hope of raising his son in a peaceful neighborhood was disrupted by the 'visual heaviness' and constant noise of a massive data center. This situation illustrates that while a project may be legally 'lawful,' it is not necessarily 'beneficial' if it fails to build up the surrounding community. We are called to consider how our advancements...
reflection.zh: 肖恩·布朗原本希望在宁静的社区抚养儿子，但这一愿望被巨大数据中心的“视觉沉重感”和持续噪音打破了。这种情况说明，虽然一个项目在法律上可能是“可行的”，但如果它不能造就周围的社区，就不一定是“有益的”。我们受召去思考我们的进步如何影响邻舍平静的生活，确保技术的发展不会以牺牲人类的福祉为代价。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.

title.en: The 'extraordinarily expensive' project reshaping a state — and drawing political battlelines
title.zh: “极其昂贵”的项目正在重塑一个州——并划定政治战线

summary.en: Victoria's Premier Ben Carroll has announced a $2 billion reduction in the cost of the state's largest infrastructure project, the Suburban Rail Loop. This pivot comes amid ongoing debate over the project's "extraordinarily expensive" nature, its disputed economic benefits, and its lengthy construction timeline.
summary.zh: 维多利亚州州长本·卡罗尔宣布，将该州最大的基础设施项目——城郊铁路环线（SRL）的成本削减20亿澳元。这一调整是在该项目“极其昂贵”、经济效益存在争议以及建设周期漫长等问题持续引发辩论之际做出的。

body.en:
Victorian Premier Ben Carroll has announced $2 billion in cuts to the state's largest infrastructure project, the Suburban Rail Loop (SRL), saying: "I respect your money."

His comments underline the controversy over the 90km underground rapid transit project, which will link Melbourne's middle suburbs and allow passengers to travel across the city without passing through the CBD.

The state government says the mega-project will reshape Melbourne into a multi-nodal city, bringing services and jobs closer to where people live, building more homes, and creating more jobs.

But its enormous cost, disputed economic benefits and lengthy construction timeline have also made it one of Australia's most controversial infrastructure projects.

Liam Davies, a lecturer in sustainability and urban planning at RMIT University, said the SRL was a step towards transforming Melbourne's city-centric public transport system into an interconnected network.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Melbourne's greatest challenge is that it has become an extraordinarily large city, physically," he told SBS News.

"We can't just adopt the transport strategy for a denser, more compact city like London. We need to do something of our own, and the SRL is an attempt to do that in a Melburnian context."

With Labor and the Coalition deeply divided on the SRL, the project's future could be decided when Victorians head to the polls in November.

The SRL will connect Melbourne's middle suburbs from Cheltenham in the south-east to Werribee in the west via Melbourne Airport through a 90km underground rail line.

The project is split into three stages. The first section — SRL East — is under construction, running from Cheltenham to Box Hill via six new underground stations. The first trains are expected by 2035.

Critics argue the mega-project's business case doesn't stack up, and the multi-billion-dollar price tag is a financial liability for Victoria, which has the second-highest debt per capita of any state or territory, behind the Northern Territory.

More than $33 billion has already been invested in SRL East, according to the premier.

A Parliamentary Budget Office analysis puts the price tag for building the East and North sections at $96.4 billion, though there is currently no fully costed estimate for the entire project, which includes the final stage, SRL West.

An evaluation last year by Infrastructure Australia — an advisory body to the federal government — found the SRL's business case was insufficiently detailed and relied on future stages to justify its benefits.

It also urged the Victorian government to develop "exit strategies" should the...
body.zh: 维多利亚州州长本·卡罗尔 (Ben Carroll) 宣布削减该州最大的基础设施项目郊区铁路环线 (SRL) 20 亿美元，并表示：“我尊重你的钱。” 他的言论凸显了关于90公里长的地下快速交通项目的争议，该项目将连接墨尔本的中郊区，让乘客无需经过中央商务区即可穿越城市。 州政府表示，这个大型项目将把墨尔本重塑为一个多节点城市，让服务和就业机会更接近人们居住的地方，建造更多房屋，创造更多就业机会。 但其巨大的成本、备受争议的经济效益以及漫长的建设工期也使其成为澳大利亚最具争议的基础设施项目之一。 皇家墨尔本理工大学可持续发展和城市规划讲师利亚姆·戴维斯 (Liam Davies) 表示，SRL 是将墨尔本以城市为中心的公共交通系统转变为互联网络的一步。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “墨尔本最大的挑战是它已经成为一个非常大的城市，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “我们不能仅仅采用像伦敦这样更密集、更紧凑的城市的交通策略。我们需要做一些我们自己的事情，SRL 就是在墨尔本的背景下尝试做到这一点。” 由于工党和联盟党在 SRL 问题上存在严重分歧，该项目的未来可能会在 11 月份维州民众前往投票时决定。 SRL将通过一条全长90公里的地下铁路线，将墨尔本中郊从东南部的切尔滕纳姆（Cheltenham）经墨尔本机场连接到西部的威勒比（Werribee）。 该项目分为三个阶段。第一部分——SRL East——正在建设中，通过六个新的地铁站从切尔滕纳姆到博士山。预计第一批列车将于 2035 年建成。 批评者认为，这个大型项目的商业案例并不成立，数十亿美元的价格标签对维多利亚州来说是一种财务负担，维多利亚州的人均债务在所有州或地区中排名第二，仅次于北领地。 据总理称，SRL East 已投资超过 330 亿美元。 议会预算办公室的分析显示，东段和北段的建设成本为 964 亿美元，但目前还没有整个项目（包括最后阶段 SRL West）的完整成本估算。 联邦政府咨询机构澳大利亚基础设施部去年的一项评估发现，SRL 的商业案例不够详细，并且依赖未来阶段来证明其效益。 它还敦促维多利亚州政府制定“退出战略”...

reflection.en: The Victorian government's decision to cut $2 billion from the Suburban Rail Loop, with Premier Ben Carroll stating "I respect your money," underscores the immense challenge of wise stewardship in large public projects. When leaders face "extraordinarily expensive" and contentious decisions that draw "political battlelines," the need for clear judgment is...
reflection.zh: 维多利亚州政府决定削减城郊铁路环线项目20亿澳元，州长本·卡罗尔表示“我尊重你们的钱”，这凸显了大型公共项目中明智管家的巨大挑战。当领导者面临“极其昂贵”且引发“政治战线”的争议性决策时，清晰的判断力至关重要。雅伟邀请所有人，特别是那些身居高位者，为影响众多生命的复杂选择，慷慨地寻求祂的智慧。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: 'Get it out': ARIA to ban AI-generated music from Australian charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚唱片业协会禁止人工智能生成的音乐进入排行榜

summary.en: ARIA has updated its code of practice to ensure that only songs that are "substantially human-made" qualify for the Australian music charts. Chief executive Annabelle Herd stated that the charts exist to celebrate human artistry and success, rather than unlicensed AI output.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚唱片业协会（ARIA）更新了其行业准则，规定只有“基本上由人类创作”的歌曲才有资格进入澳大利亚音乐排行榜。首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德表示，排行榜旨在庆祝人类的艺术造诣和成就，而非未经授权的人工智能产出。

body.en:
Music will need to be "substantially human-made" in order to qualify for Australia's main music chart, in an industry bid to stamp out AI-generated tracks.

Songs wholly generated using artificial intelligence will no longer be eligible for the ARIA charts from Friday, in an update to The Australian Recording Industry Association's (ARIA) code of practice.

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said a chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would "undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to present".

"The ARIA charts are about tracking consumption and sales of music in Australia, but they're also about celebrating human artistry and success," Herd told ABC radio.

"We're not particularly interested in including AI-generated music as part of that process, particularly when it's taking up a spot from an Australian artist in the chart."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

AI-assisted songs will still feature on the charts, but they must be substantially human-made and raise no stream or chart manipulation concerns.

"I'm sure that there are a lot of artists that are using AI tools to enhance creativity, to do really cool, new, exciting things," Herd said.

"Artists have always been at the forefront of new tech ... it's made some of the best music ever created, and no doubt AI will create some really exciting evolution of that."

Songs on the ARIA charts that use AI include Gold Coast-based DJ and producer Josh Fawaz's dance track Like a Prayer, which is fourth on the ARIA's top 20 Australian singles after peaking at number two in May.

A dance cover of Madonna's 1989 hit, generative AI is credited for the drums and vocals on the track, according to Spotify.

Australian electronic band Peking Duk supported the association's call to outlaw generative AI from the charts, claiming it was "removing the human experience from life".

"AI is using our stuff. It's using a lot of our peers' stuff, you know, people we know," band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show .

"There is so much good art in Australia and something like AI coming along and kind of sweeping the charts and all that jazz, it's like, get it out."

ARIA's decision heeds global AI principles drawn up by the record industry's peak body, The International Federation of the Phonographic Industry, in July.

The federation said the guidelines would be rolled out to official charts in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia and advocated to more than 20 other official chart programs in Europe and the Pacific, including the ARIAs.

body.zh: 音乐需要“实质上是人造的”才能有资格进入澳大利亚主要音乐排行榜，行业努力消除人工智能生成的曲目。 根据澳大利亚唱片工业协会 (ARIA) 行为准则的更新，从周五开始，完全使用人工智能生成的歌曲将不再符合 ARIA 排行榜的资格。 ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示，奖励未经许可的人工智能输出的图表将“削弱我们现有的录制音乐的基础”。 “ARIA 排行榜旨在追踪澳大利亚音乐的消费和销售，但它们也旨在庆祝人类的艺术和成功，”赫德告诉美国广播公司广播电台。 “我们对将人工智能生成的音乐纳入这一过程并不是特别感兴趣，特别是当它在排行榜上占据了澳大利亚艺术家的位置时。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 人工智能辅助的歌曲仍将出现在排行榜上，但它们必须基本上是人造的，并且不会引起流媒体或排行榜操纵问题。 “我确信有很多艺术家正在使用人工智能工具来增强创造力，做一些非常酷、新、令人兴奋的事情，”赫德说。 “艺术家一直走在新技术的最前沿……它创造了一些有史以来最好的音乐，毫无疑问，人工智能将创造一些真正令人兴奋的演变。” ARIA 排行榜上使用人工智能的歌曲包括黄金海岸 DJ 兼制作人 Josh Fawaz 的舞曲《Like a Prayer》，该歌曲在 5 月份达到峰值第二名后，在 ARIA 前 20 名澳大利亚单曲中排名第四。 据 Spotify 称，麦当娜 1989 年的热门歌曲的舞曲翻唱，歌曲中的鼓和人声均归功于生成人工智能。 澳大利亚电子乐队 Peking Duk 支持该协会从排行榜上取缔生成式人工智能的呼吁，声称它“消除了人类的生活体验”。 “人工智能正在使用我们的东西。它正在使用我们很多同行的东西，你知道，我们认识的人，”乐队成员亚当·海德告诉第九频道的今日节目。 “澳大利亚有很多优秀的艺术，像人工智能这样的东西正在出现，席卷了排行榜，所有的爵士乐，就像，把它拿出来。” ARIA 的决定考虑了唱片行业最高机构国际唱片业联合会于 7 月制定的全球人工智能原则。 该联合会表示，该指南将推广到拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和东南亚的官方排行榜，并推广到欧洲和太平洋地区的 20 多个其他官方排行榜项目，包括 ARIA。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

Scripture teaches that we are created in the image of Yahweh, the ultimate Creator, which gives our creative work a dignity that machines cannot replicate. Protecting the space for...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚唱片业协会坚持音乐必须“基本上由人类创作”，这提醒我们，艺术不仅仅是悦耳声音的排列，更是人类灵魂的表达。圣经教导我们，我们是按照创造主雅伟的形象造的，这赋予了人类创作一种机器无法复制的尊严。保护人类艺术创作的空间，正是对上帝安置在我们里面的独特生命火花和创作意图的尊重。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

title.en: A common tax misconception could catch some Australians by surprise
title.zh: 常见的税务误区可能让部分澳大利亚人措手不及

summary.en: Online sellers in Australia are being warned that selling unwanted household items or clothes on platforms like eBay and Facebook Marketplace may carry tax obligations, as there is no minimum sales threshold to trigger a tax declaration.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的在线卖家受到提醒，在eBay和Facebook Marketplace等平台上出售闲置家居用品或衣物可能涉及纳税义务，因为触发税务申报并没有最低销售额限制。

body.en:
It’s now easier than ever to sell your unwanted clothes or household items online in Australia. Many popular sites, from eBay, Depop, Facebook Marketplace to newly arrived competitors like Vinted, have either scrapped or limited their seller’s fees, depending on the location, value and number of items sold.

So when do you need to declare your online sales income to the Australian Taxation Office and pay tax on it?

The answer can be as messy as your wardrobe. Be aware there is no minimum value of sales that triggers taxation obligations in Australia.

Digging into the law reveals key questions to consider whether you’re spring cleaning your wardrobe to get some cash for the latest fashion, selling a more valuable asset, or starting to run a business.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Two of the biggest online sales sites, eBay and Amazon, are required to provide lots of transaction data to the tax office.

What about selling goods on other platforms? The tax office may be tracking that too. Its tentacles are vast, with more than 600 million transactions reported and matched to taxpayers every year from a wide variety of private and public sources.

Even if a platform is not required to report, the transactions may still be captured through credit and debit card payment systems, such as Stripe or Square.

The tax office can also request information from the banks. It may even gather information via insurers on unexplained wealth based on "lifestyle assets" – such as cars, boats or art – you may own. There are also examples of taxpayers being caught out with unexplained deposits leading to hefty tax bills.

Let’s say you found a dress in your wardrobe that you bought for A$250, wore once, but don’t like. So you decide to sell it on eBay or Amazon, rather than giving it away.

You list it and sell it for $100. While you’ve now got $100 more than before, you have really lost $150 overall.

This is not a sound business model. Anything you sell actually comes at a cost to you; think profit, not just sales.

The tax office is unlikely to be interested in these types of occasional, low-value, generally loss-making personal-type activities.

In this scenario, where you’re just cashing in on your existing wardrobe, the tax office is likely to consider it private in nature and just a "hobby".

This is unlikely to create a tax bill. However, you still may need to declare certain activity and have records to support your position.

title.en: 'Contaminated': How deadly bird flu crossed a new threshold in Australia
title.zh: 澳大利亚达到“毁灭性”禽流感里程碑。接下来会发生什么？

summary.en: The deadly H5N1 strain of avian influenza has been detected in a mammal in South Australia, marking the first confirmed bird-to-mammal transmission in the country. Experts warn this is just the beginning and anticipate widespread mortalities among native birds and mammals.
summary.zh: 致命的H5N1禽流感病毒株已在南澳大利亚的一种哺乳动物身上被检测到，这标志着该国首次确认禽类与哺乳动物之间的传播。专家警告说，这仅仅是个开始，预计当地鸟类和哺乳动物将出现大规模死亡。

body.en:
The "devastating" H5N1 variant of avian influenza marked a grim milestone on Sunday as the first confirmed case of transmission between bird and mammal species was recorded, with experts warning the worst is yet to come.

A long-nosed fur seal was confirmed to have died of the disease in coastal South Australia, with a second case being investigated in a seal in The Pages Conservation Park islands near Kangaroo Island on Monday.

Earlier, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the country needed to be "realistic" about the impact this illness will have on native wildlife.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear," Watt told ABC television.

Sean Dooley of the avian conservation group BirdLife Australia told SBS News that the virus could have an ecology-shifting impact.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"That's why we need an effective response, where we can, to mitigate the losses.

"We also need a massive increase in the resources that go into ensuring resilient populations of as many of our species, or else we're going to be facing a real ongoing crisis beyond the actual outbreak."

Avian influenza, a flu-type virus, is airborne and contracted by birds and other mammals when they breathe or ingest it from an infected animal.

Robyn Alders, an honorary professor at the Development Policy Centre at Australian National University, told SBS News that the virus also survives outside of a host animal.

"Even if you can't see a diseased carcass or a dead animal, it doesn't mean that the environment there is safe," she said.

"Particularly now that we're starting to see areas where you've got larger die-offs, the potential contamination in that area is going to be significant."

In cooler temperatures where water is present, Alders said there is evidence H5N1 can survive for days.

In areas where the virus has yet to arrive, Dooley recommends people continue spending time in nature and report anything they suspect could be bird flu-related to the emergency animal disease hotline.

"That's still really valuable because it can help slow the spread as they remove those birds which are potential sources of infection," he said.

Cats are particularly susceptible to the disease, and Alders recommends people keep their cats indoors as the virus has a "50 per cent" mortality rate for them.

Bird flu vaccinations are underway in specific, suitable populations at the moment, but experts question whether the government is adequately prepared.

Dooley said the country is in a stronger position now than it was a few years ago, but that government claims to have "done everything...

body.en: A taxi driver was killed in a three-vehicle collision in North Lantau on Tuesday evening. At least nine others were injured in the crash on Cheung Tung Road at around 8pm. The collision involved a taxi, a single-decker Discovery Bay bus and a truck. Police said the taxi driver was trapped inside the vehicle before he was freed by emergency staff and rushed to the North Lantau Hospital where he was pronounced dead. A taxi passenger and eight people on the bus were injured. The Transport Department said all lanes of Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay, as well as the airport-bound slow lane of the North Lantau Highway, were closed for traffic because of the accident. summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A company linked to forced shopping has been banned from receiving inbound tour groups for 30 days. The Travel Industry Authority said on Tuesday that the suspension of Kaiser Jewellery International Limited, which is registered under the Administrative Scheme for Registered Shops for Inbound Tour Groups, will last from Wednesday to September 24. The shop sells various items including jewellery and clothing. The authority said it had failed to prevent forced shopping involving mainland visitors in February. It also failed to take appropriate measures to ensure that no unauthorised personnel would carry out promotional activities inside the store, the authority added. The watchdog said it has zero tolerance for forced shopping and any behaviour that damages the reputation of Hong Kong’s tourism industry. It also ordered directors, managers and all frontline staff of the shop to complete training courses within a month. The authority added that it had engaged in exchanges with mainland authorities to step up supervision. DAB lawmaker Nixie Lam welcomed the 30-day suspension, saying any misconduct that harms tourists’ interests and damages Hong Kong’s image must be punished. “It does send a pretty powerful industry-wide reminder that those registered shops cannot simply just profit from doing this sort of thing,” she told RTHK. “I think it is important for all those shop owners and also their shop staff to understand that pressuring visitors or having all these sort of illegal acts are something that we really need to stop immediately.” She added that all registered shops authorised to receive tour groups are duty-bound to protect the interests of travellers. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 一家涉嫌强迫购物的公司被禁止接待入境旅游团30天。旅游业监管局周二表示，根据入境旅游团注册店铺管理计划注册的凯撒珠宝国际有限公司将暂停营业，为期周三至9月24日。该店出售珠宝和服装等多种商品。当局表示，二月份未能阻止大陆游客被迫购物。当局补充说，该公司也未能采取适当措施确保未经授权的人员不会在店内进行促销活动。该监管机构表示，对强制购物以及任何损害香港旅游业声誉的行为采取零容忍态度。并要求该店的董事、经理和所有一线员工在一个月内完成培训课程。该局补充说，已与内地当局进行交流，以加强监管。民建联议员林郑月娥对暂停30天表示欢迎，并表示任何损害游客利益和损害香港形象的不当行为都必须受到惩罚。 “这确实向全行业发出了一个非常有力的提醒，即那些注册商店不能仅仅通过做这种事情来获利，”她告诉香港电台。 “我认为，对于所有店主和店员来说，了解向游客施压或所有这些非法行为是我们真正需要立即停止的事情，这一点很重要。”她补充说，所有有权接待旅行团的注册商店都有责任保护游客的利益。埃德蒙·方编辑

title.en: Crunch culture and tight timelines blamed for 15 construction site deaths this year
title.zh: 今年香港建筑工地因“紧迫文化”和严格工期导致15人死亡

summary.en: Construction industry representatives in Hong Kong have attributed 15 fatal worksite accidents this year to a pervasive "crunch culture" and tight timelines. Union chair Chau Sze-kit explained that this environment pushes management to prioritize speed and convenience, leading to shortcuts on safety procedures to meet...
summary.zh: 香港建筑业代表将今年发生的15起致命工地事故归咎于普遍存在的“紧迫文化”和严格的工期。工会主席周思杰解释说，这种环境促使管理层优先考虑速度和便利，为了赶工期和避免罚款，从而在安全程序上走捷径。

body.en: Construction sector representatives have blamed the industry’s crunch culture for the 15 fatal worksite accidents recorded in Hong Kong since the beginning of this year. Construction workers in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Speaking on RTHK radio, Hong Kong Construction Industry Employees General Union chair Chau Sze-kit said that aloof attitudes toward occupational safety stem from a pervasive culture of rushing work at construction sites, pushing workers to prioritise convenience and foregoing precautions. “When frontline management faces deadlines and potential penalties, they may choose to take shortcuts on certain safety procedures,” Chau said in Cantonese. Chau also said the industry-wide practice of awarding contracts to the lowest bidder meant safety was sacrificed for speed, adding that contractors may offload the pressure they face to subcontractors who have “no bargaining power.” Speaking on the same RTHK programme, Lawrence Ng, chair of the Construction Workers Registration Board at the Construction Industry Council, said that worksite bosses are often pressed to get more done in less time to compensate for increasingly frequent delays caused by extreme weather. A worker at a construction site in Hong Kong on February 13, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. He cited a survey conducted by the Council indicating that 5 to 7 per cent of frontline managers and workers have “extremely weak” safety awareness. Safety culture Ng’s remarks come a day after Construction Industry Council chairperson Thomas Ho said during a construction safety event that worksite fatalities are continuing to climb in spite of harsher penalties levied against negligent employers. In April 2023, Hong Kong amended the Occupational Safety and Occupational Health Legislation Ordinance , raising the maximum penalty for employers who commit serious safety violations from HK$500,000 to HK$10 million. Violators also face up to two years in prison. Ho said the 15 deaths so far this year was an increase compared to before the penalty was raised. “Safety culture hasn’t made its way to the worksite,” Ho said in Cantonese. “Out of the 15 [fatalities]… even a safety supervisor died. Why? Because we have only paid lip service and haven’t truly fulfilled our responsibility.” Construction workers in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Crunch culture is one of the biggest killers on construction sites,” he added. Delivering an address at the same event, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said that worksite accidents more broadly had decreased by 20 per cent between 2023 and 2025, following the implementation of the “4S” Smart Site Safety System. This enables early identification of potential safety hazards through smart devices and communication networks for...
body.zh: 建筑业代表将今年年初以来香港发生的 15 起工地致命事故归咎于该行业的加班文化。香港的建筑工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港建造业总工会主席周士杰在香港电台发表讲话时表示，对职业安全的冷漠态度源于建筑工地普遍存在的赶工文化，促使工人优先考虑方便而忽视预防措施。 “当一线管理层面临最后期限和潜在的处罚时，他们可能会选择在某些安全程序上走捷径，”周用粤语说。周还表示，全行业将合同授予最低投标人的做法意味着为了速度而牺牲安全，并补充说承包商可能会将他们面临的压力转嫁给“没有讨价还价能力”的分包商。建造业议会建造业工人注册管理局主席吴遵义在香港电台同一节目中表示，工地老板经常被迫在更短的时间内完成更多工作，以弥补极端天气造成的日益频繁的延误。 2023 年 2 月 13 日，香港建筑工地的一名工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。他援引该委员会进行的一项调查显示，5％至7％的一线管理人员和工人的安全意识“极薄弱”。安全文化 吴恩达发表上述言论的前一天，建造业议会主席托马斯·何（Thomas Ho）在一次建筑安全活动中表示，尽管对疏忽的雇主处以更严厉的处罚，但工地死亡人数仍在继续攀升。 2023年4月，香港修订《职业安全及职业健康法例条例》，将严重违反安全规定的雇主的最高罚款由50万港元提高至1,000万港元。违法者还将面临最高两年的监禁。何说，今年迄今为止的15人死亡人数比提高处罚前有所增加。 “安全文化还没有深入到工地，”何先生用粤语说道。 “15人（死亡）中……连一名安全主管都死了。为什么？因为我们只是说说而已，并没有真正履行我们的责任。”香港的建筑工人。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “紧缩文化是建筑工地最大的杀手之一，”他补充道。发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 在同一活动中发表讲话时表示，在实施“4S”智能工地安全系统后，2023 年至 2025 年间，工地事故总体减少了 20%。这使得能够通过智能设备和通信网络及早识别潜在的安全隐患......

reflection.en: The tragic loss of 15 lives in Hong Kong's construction sector this year, attributed to a "crunch culture" that prioritizes deadlines over safety, reminds us of the profound dangers when financial pressures overshadow human well-being. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, and here we see its devastating impact on...
reflection.zh: 今年香港建筑业因“紧迫文化”而导致15人丧生，这提醒我们，当经济压力凌驾于人的福祉之上时，会带来多么深重的危险。雅伟的话语警告我们，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它对被迫放弃预防措施的工人造成了毁灭性的影响。这种情况呼吁我们重新评估行业惯例，确保没有人为了速度或利润而牺牲生命。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Chinese vessel caught with banned shark fin in Pacific
title.zh: 中国渔船在太平洋被查获携带禁用鱼翅

summary.en: Kiribati, a small Pacific nation with growing ties to Beijing, detained a Chinese vessel this month for illegally harvesting shark fins, according to its maritime police. The practice of finning live sharks and discarding their bodies is banned in much of the Pacific but continues due to demand in Asia. The vessel was...
summary.zh: 据基里巴斯海事警察称，与北京关系日益密切的太平洋小国基里巴斯本月扣押了一艘中国渔船，因其非法捕捞鱼翅。将活鲨鱼割鳍并将其尸体丢弃的做法在太平洋大部分地区被禁止，但由于亚洲的需求而持续存在。该船是8月3日至14日期间由11个太平洋岛国进行的一次监视行动中扣押的四艘船只之一，美国海岸警卫队和一架澳大利亚军用飞机在部分地区提...

body.en: Kiribati, a tiny Pacific neighbour to Hawaii that has grown ties with Beijing, detained a Chinese vessel this month for illegally harvesting shark fins, its maritime police told AFP. Sharks. File photo: Klaus Stiefel/Flickr. The practice of cutting fins off live sharks and throwing the carcasses back into the sea is banned in much of the Pacific Ocean, but persists due to demand in East and Southeast Asia. The Chinese ship was among four vessels detained in a surveillance crackdown by 11 Pacific island nations between August 3 to 14, assisted by the US Coast Guard in some areas and an Australian military aircraft. Kiribati, however, operates its own patrol boat. The vessel was licensed to ply Kiribati’s waters but was detained by the maritime police after inspectors found shark fins on board, commander Tom Redfern told AFP. “It was escorted back to Christmas Island for further investigation,” he said, referring to a large atoll belonging to Kiribati and located south of Hawaii. Kiribati has an exclusive economic zone spanning 3.5 million square kilometres (1.4 million square miles) of ocean, and has drawn interest from Chinese state companies since switching diplomatic ties from Taiwan in 2019. A Kiribati flag. Photo: Kahunapule Michael Johnson/Flickr. It also hosts Chinese police, a decision the United States has said risks fuelling regional tensions. “A Kiribati Police maritime boarding officer, not under a shiprider agreement, boarded and inspected it, finding that the vessel was breaching its condition of licence by keeping and retaining shark fins onboard,” said Redfern. Kiribati has recently strengthened cooperation with France, with French military personnel due to arrive next month on Christmas Island to rebuild local police stations. The practice of removing shark fins is banned across the region. Andrew Chin, a fisheries researcher at Australia’s James Cook University, said finning had led to “massive declines” in shark numbers, prompting stringent controls in the Pacific. A bowl of shark fin soup. Photo: Janine Cheung/Flickr. “Because it is now illegal, if people are doing it, it is going to be hidden and really hard to detect,” he said. Research on the DNA of thousands of shark fins sold in Hong Kong markets pointed to its origins in the region. “We have seen evidence of illegal trade from the western and eastern sides of the Pacific,” Demian Chapman, who conducted the research as director of the Sharks and Rays Conservation Research Program at Mote Marine Laboratory in Florida, said. There have been other cases of Chinese vessels violating the finning ban, he told AFP. Reduced demand in China for shark fin soup, including a ban on serving it at government functions,...
body.zh: 基里巴斯是夏威夷的一个太平洋小邻国，与北京发展了关系，该国海警告诉法新社，该国本月扣押了一艘非法捕捞鱼翅的中国船只。鲨鱼。资料照片：Klaus Stiefel/Flickr。太平洋大部分地区禁止割下活鲨鱼鳍并将尸体扔回海中的做法，但由于东亚和东南亚的需求，这种做法仍然存在。 8月3日至14日，在美国海岸警卫队和一架澳大利亚军机的协助下，11个太平洋岛国在部分地区的监视行动中扣留了四艘中国船只，这艘中国船只就是其中之一。然而，基里巴斯拥有自己的巡逻艇。船长汤姆·雷德芬告诉法新社，该船获得在基里巴斯水域航行的许可，但在检查人员在船上发现鱼翅后被海警扣留。他说：“它被护送回圣诞岛进行进一步调查。”圣诞岛是属于基里巴斯、位于夏威夷南部的一个大型环礁。基里巴斯拥有占地 350 万平方公里（140 万平方英里）海洋的专属经济区，自 2019 年与台湾断交以来，吸引了中国国有企业的兴趣。一面基里巴斯国旗。照片：Kahunapule Michael Johnson/Flickr。它还驻有中国警察，美国称这一决定可能会加剧地区紧张局势。雷德芬说：“基里巴斯警方的一名海事登船官员在没有签订随船观察员协议的情况下登上并检查了该船，发现该船在船上保留鱼翅违反了许可证条件。”基里巴斯最近加强了与法国的合作，法国军事人员将于下个月抵达圣诞岛重建当地警察局。该地区禁止去除鱼翅的做法。澳大利亚詹姆斯库克大学渔业研究员安德鲁·钦表示，割鳍导致鲨鱼数量“大幅下降”，促使太平洋地区采取严格控制措施。一碗鱼翅汤。照片：Janine Cheung/Flickr。 “因为它现在是非法的，如果有人这样做，它就会被隐藏起来，很难被发现，”他说。对香港市场上出售的数千个鱼翅的 DNA 研究表明，其起源于该地区。 “我们已经看到了来自太平洋西侧和东侧非法贸易的证据，”佛罗里达州莫特海洋实验室鲨鱼和鳐鱼保护研究项目主任德米安·查普曼（Demian Chapman）表示。他告诉法新社，中国船只还发生过其他违反割鳍禁令的案件。中国对鱼翅汤的需求减少，包括禁止在政府职能中提供鱼翅汤，...

reflection.en: The illegal harvesting of shark fins, as seen with the detained Chinese vessel, represents a profound disregard for the natural world. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,' a principle that extends beyond human beings to the vulnerable creatures and ecosystems that share our planet. May we be moved to advocate for...
reflection.zh: 被扣押的中国渔船所涉及的非法捕捞鱼翅行为，体现了对自然界的严重漠视。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口辩护”，这一原则不仅适用于人类，也适用于与我们共享地球的脆弱生物和生态系统。愿我们能被激励去为那些不能发声的生命代求，保护雅伟所创造的微妙生命平衡。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.en: A team of scientists from Caltech and Yale University has shown for the first time how to accurately quantify an important quantum phenomenon in metals, called the Kondo effect, for specific real materials. Unlike previous approaches, which for decades have relied on simplified...

body.en: A team of scientists from Caltech and Yale University has shown for the first time how to accurately quantify an important quantum phenomenon in metals, called the Kondo effect, for specific real materials. Unlike previous approaches, which for decades have relied on simplified models to qualitatively describe the effect, the new work uses the actual atomic and electronic structures of materials to solve the problem directly.
body.zh: 来自加州理工学院和耶鲁大学的科学家团队首次展示了如何针对特定的真实材料准确量化金属中一种重要的量子现象，即近藤效应。与几十年来一直依靠简化模型来定性描述效果的以前的方法不同，这项新工作使用材料的实际原子和电子结构来直接解决问题。

title.en: Companies, regulators and stakeholders shape sustainability reporting, says researcher
title.zh: 研究人员表示，公司、监管机构和利益相关者共同制定可持续发展报告

summary.en: Sustainability reporting is shaped by the social, economic and political environment in which companies operate. New research shows how corporate culture, cross-border regulatory influences and stakeholder involvement in standard-setting shape how reporting practices evolve over...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Sustainability reporting is shaped by the social, economic and political environment in which companies operate. New research shows how corporate culture, cross-border regulatory influences and stakeholder involvement in standard-setting shape how reporting practices evolve over time.

Sustainability reporting may appear primarily as a compliance requirement or communication practice, but behind reporting requirements lies a longer process through which practices and expectations develop and gradually become established. In her doctoral thesis, Piia Korri studies the factors shaping the institutionalization of sustainability reporting.

Political priorities differ across jurisdictions, contributing to different regulatory environments for sustainability reporting. In the U.S., sustainability reporting is less regulated at the federal level than in the EU.

"When reporting is less standardized, there is more room for corporate culture to influence disclosure practices and ESG ratings, potentially affecting investors and others who rely on this information," Korri explains.

Regulatory differences across jurisdictions do not, however, mean that firms are influenced only by the rules of their home jurisdiction. Korri finds that regulation can also have cross-border effects: Following the implementation of the EU's Non-Financial Reporting Directive, U.S. firms with EU subsidiaries showed greater improvements in sustainability transparency and performance than the comparison firms.

"Foreign subsidiaries can expose multinational firms to regulatory developments outside their home jurisdiction. These effects can extend to the parent company, even when it falls outside the regulation's direct scope," Korri says.

Even in the EU, where sustainability reporting has become increasingly regulated over time, standardization involves trade-offs. Stakeholders involved in developing sustainability reporting standards bring different priorities and perspectives to the process. This can create tensions between ambitions for broader change and established ways of working, as well as between flexibility and more prescriptive reporting requirements.

"The same requirements can support the aims of some stakeholder groups while imposing costs or constraints on others," Korri explains.

Overall, the findings show that sustainability reporting is shaped by several factors: corporate culture and practices, the cross-border spillover effects of regulation, and interactions among stakeholders involved in standard-setting.

MA in English, copy editor since 2021 with experience in higher education...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 可持续发展报告是由公司运营所处的社会、经济和政治环境决定的。新的研究表明，企业文化、跨境监管影响和利益相关者参与标准制定如何影响报告实践随着时间的推移而演变。 可持续发展报告可能主要表现为合规要求或沟通实践，但报告要求背后隐藏着一个较长的过程，在这个过程中实践和期望不断发展并逐渐建立起来。 Piia Korri 在她的博士论文中研究了影响可持续发展报告制度化的因素。 不同司法管辖区的政治优先事项不同，导致可持续发展报告的监管环境不同。在美国，可持续发展报告在联邦层面的监管程度低于欧盟。 “当报告标准化程度较低时，企业文化就有更大的空间影响披露实践和 ESG 评级，从而可能影响投资者和其他依赖此信息的人，”Korri 解释道。 然而，不同司法管辖区的监管差异并不意味着公司仅受其所在司法管辖区规则的影响。 Korri 发现监管也会产生跨境影响：欧盟非财务报告指令实施后，拥有欧盟子公司的美国公司在可持续发展透明度和绩效方面比对照公司有了更大的进步。 “外国子公司可能会让跨国公司面临其母国管辖范围之外的监管发展。这些影响可能会延伸到母公司，即使母公司不属于监管的直接范围，”科里说。 即使在欧盟，随着时间的推移，可持续发展报告受到越来越多的监管，标准化也涉及权衡。参与制定可持续发展报告标准的利益相关者为流程带来了不同的优先事项和观点。这可能会在更广泛变革的雄心与既定工作方式之间、以及灵活性与更具规范性的报告要求之间造成紧张关系。 “同样的要求可以支持某些利益相关者群体的目标，同时给其他利益相关者群体带来成本或限制，”Korri 解释道。 总体而言，研究结果表明，可持续发展报告受到以下几个因素的影响：企业文化和实践、监管的跨境溢出效应以及参与标准制定的利益相关者之间的互动。 英语硕士，自 2021 年起担任文案编辑，拥有高等教育经验...

title.en: Genetic evidence reveals how goosegrass colonized a newly formed volcanic island
title.zh: 遗传证据揭示了牛筋草如何在新形成的火山岛上定居

summary.en: Opportunities to directly observe how life colonizes newly formed land and how ecosystems subsequently develop are exceedingly rare. In a study published in the Journal of Plant Research, researchers at University of Tsukuba used genetic analyses to investigate the origin of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Opportunities to directly observe how life colonizes newly formed land and how ecosystems subsequently develop are exceedingly rare. In a study published in the Journal of Plant Research, researchers at University of Tsukuba used genetic analyses to investigate the origin of Eleusine indica, a grass species found on Nishinoshima, an active volcanic island in the northwestern Pacific south of mainland Japan. Having newly emerged, the island offers a unique natural laboratory for understanding the earliest stages of biological colonization and ecosystem development.
body.zh: 直接观察生命如何在新形成的土地上定居以及生态系统随后如何发展的机会极其罕见。在《植物研究杂志》上发表的一项研究中，筑波大学的研究人员利用遗传分析来调查牛筋草的起源，这是一种在日本大陆以南西北太平洋的活火山岛西之岛发现的草种。该岛是新出现的，为了解生物殖民和生态系统发展的最早阶段提供了一个独特的自然实验室。

title.en: Expert pieces together puzzle from fragments of 1,600-year-old Roman text
title.zh: 专家将 1600 年前的罗马文本碎片拼凑成拼图

summary.en: A Roman law expert at the University of Cincinnati edited and translated a Latin legal text he pieced together from fragments that surprisingly survived in the Egyptian sands for more than 1,600 years. What's less surprising? It's about taxes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A Roman law expert at the University of Cincinnati edited and translated a Latin legal text he pieced together from fragments that surprisingly survived in the Egyptian sands for more than 1,600 years. What's less surprising? It's about taxes.

UC Assistant Professor of Classics Matthijs Wibier translated the double-sided page, which does not appear in other known books from ancient Rome. He said the text likely came from a small compilation of imperial laws from the late fourth century that was distributed for official use by tax officials or private use by landowners or their attorneys.

"We don't have a book like this that we know of, which makes it the first of its kind," Wibier said. "I don't think it contained thousands of laws like most of the Roman codes we know. I think it was a book that traveling officials could put in their pocket."

Made from animal skin, the 50 fragments come from a collection of other Egyptian antiquities at the Penn Museum at the University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia. The museum obtained the fragments from an antiquities dealer in Egypt in 1911.

With the help of the museum, Wibier pieced together the page like a puzzle from the seven largest tattered fragments, which together resemble an archipelago.

These pieces add to our understanding of imperial law under two emperors, Constantius II and Julian the Apostate, who ruled between 337 and 363, Wibier said.

Translating even fragmentary texts is extremely valuable because precious few books from that period survive intact. Scholars must rely on damaged or partial manuscripts to recreate them. And these laws, in turn, tell scholars about daily life, society and the economy in ancient Rome, from the priorities of the government to how private conflicts were resolved.

Wibier said one side of the page has three examples of red ink that were added to highlight something important.

From clues such as the absence of these highlights on the reverse side of the page, along with the imperial decrees discussed, Wibier was able to determine which way the pages faced in the book.

One side of animal skin is smooth, while the other is more textured. The textured side of the page came first, representing the odd-numbered page that sits on the right side of the book when opened. This means the opposite side of the animal skin appeared on the left side of the opened book.

Wibier used ultraviolet light to help draw out the contrast in the ink for the recovery of the Latin text and its translation. His interest in Latin is what first drew him to classics, he said.

title.en: Trust launches 'first-of-its-kind' nature survey
title.zh: 信托基金发起“史无前例”的自然调查

summary.en: A wildlife group says "everyone can get involved with protecting nature" by taking part in research.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A wildlife trust has said it has launched a first-of-its-kind survey to help find out how people feel about nature and guide future conservation efforts.

The Suffolk Wildlife Trust (SWT), in collaboration with the University of Suffolk, has brought out the Great Suffolk Nature Survey, which quizzes participants on the county's "struggling" wildlife.

It asks about their experiences with local wildlife, how they get involved with local nature, and their attitudes towards conservation, climate change and environmental projects.

The short survey comes weeks after a devastating wildfire at Dunwich Heath and nearby RSPB Minsmere destroyed vital wildlife habitats, which could take years to recover.

Jack Cripps, head of marketing and communications at SWT, said: "The county's landscapes and wildlife are a huge part of what I and so many others who live here are proud of.

"But our wildlife is struggling and we're really starting to feel the impacts of our changing climate. This survey will go a bit deeper into what local people think and feel about nature.

"Everyone can get involved with protecting nature, and the results of the survey will guide Suffolk Wildlife Trust's future community projects and campaigning."

This is the first time SWT has run its own survey, although it has previously gathered local responses as part of the nationwide The Great Big Nature Survey.

Hannah Page, from the University of Suffolk, said it was "delighted" to be supporting the trust with the "important project".

She also said there would be an opportunity for a student from the university to help roll out the survey thanks to a paid student placement from the county council.

body.zh: 野生动物信托基金表示，它已经启动了一项史无前例的调查，以帮助了解人们对自然的感受并指导未来的保护工作。 萨福克野生动物信托基金 (SWT) 与萨福克大学合作推出了萨福克大自然调查，该调查对参与者进行了有关该县“挣扎”野生动物的调查。 它询问了他们与当地野生动物的经历，他们如何参与当地自然，以及他们对保护、气候变化和环境项目的态度。 这项简短的调查是在邓里奇希思 (Dunwich Heath) 和附近的皇家鸟类保护协会明斯米尔 (RSPB Minsmere) 发生毁灭性野火摧毁了重要的野生动物栖息地几周后进行的，这些栖息地可能需要数年时间才能恢复。 SWT 营销和传播主管杰克·克里普斯 (Jack Cripps) 表示：“该县的风景和野生动物是我和许多住在这里的其他人感到自豪的重要组成部分。 “但是我们的野生动物正在挣扎，我们确实开始感受到气候变化的影响。这项调查将更深入地了解当地人对自然的看法和感受。 “每个人都可以参与保护自然，调查结果将指导萨福克野生动物信托基金未来的社区项目和活动。” 这是 SWT 第一次进行自己的调查，尽管它之前已经收集了当地的反馈作为全国性大自然调查的一部分。 萨福克大学的汉娜·佩奇表示，“很高兴”通过“重要项目”支持该信托基金。 她还表示，由于县议会为学生提供了付费安置，大学学生将有机会帮助开展这项调查。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注萨福克新闻。

title.en: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
title.zh: 带状疱疹疫苗与痴呆症风险降低24%相关

summary.en: Older adults who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine were 24% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over four years in a study of more than 500,000 people. Researchers estimate the difference could amount to roughly one dementia case prevented for every 17 people, suggesting a significant secondary benefit to...
summary.zh: 一项针对超过50万人的研究显示，接种Shingrix带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性降低了24%。研究人员估计，每17名接种疫苗的人中就可能减少一例痴呆症病例，这表明该疫苗具有显著的额外健康益处。

body.en:
Older adults who received a shingles vaccine after entering a skilled nursing facility were less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over the following four years, according to a new study. Researchers found that vaccinated adults had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with those who did not receive the vaccine.

The analysis drew on Medicare data and health records from more than 500,000 adults age 66 and older who were admitted to skilled nursing facilities for either short-term or long-term care. Researchers compared patients who received at least one dose of the recombinant shingles vaccine, known as RZV or Shingrix, with patients who remained unvaccinated. Shingrix was introduced in 2017 and is currently the only shingles vaccine available on the market.

"A lot of previous studies with similar results focused on an older vaccine," said study author Kaley Hayes, an assistant professor at Brown University's School of Public Health. "This study looks at the newest vaccine only in an older, vulnerable adult population who were not up to date with shingles vaccination and are at a very clear clinical point in care: entering a skilled nursing facility."

The results are consistent with several earlier studies involving a previous shingles vaccine that also found an association between shingles vaccination and a reduced risk of dementia.

"It fits into this large puzzle that's just starting to come together that the vaccines are effective at preventing shingles and also appear to have neuroprotective benefits as well," said Hayes, who is also the associate director of pharmacoepidemiology for Brown's Center for Gerontology and Healthcare Research.

Hayes led the study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine , with researchers from Brown, the University of Delaware, the Providence Veterans Affairs Medical Center and other institutions.

The researchers used a technique called target trial emulation to analyze the data. This approach attempts to recreate some of the conditions of a randomized clinical trial in situations where conducting such a trial is not practical.

The study included Medicare claims and electronic health records from patients admitted to more than 5,500 skilled nursing facilities nationwide between 2017 and 2022. Of the 509,926 people included in the analysis, just 8,843 received the shingles vaccine.

Participants had to be eligible for shingles vaccination and could not have previously been diagnosed with dementia.

After four years of follow-up, adults who had received at least one of the two Shingrix doses were substantially less likely to receive a dementia diagnosis. Dementia developed in 18.8% of vaccinated participants, compared with 24.6% of those who were not vaccinated.
